/-- A raw natural exponent triple `(x,y,z)`. -/
structure Raw where
  x : ℕ
  y : ℕ
  z : ℕ
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

namespace Raw

@[ext] theorem ext {p q : Raw} (hx : p.x = q.x) (hy : p.y = q.y) (hz : p.z = q.z) :
    p = q := by
  cases p
  cases q
  simp_all

def add (p q : Raw) : Raw := ⟨p.x + q.x, p.y + q.y, p.z + q.z⟩
def zero : Raw := ⟨0, 0, 0⟩

instance : Add Raw := ⟨add⟩
instance : Zero Raw := ⟨zero⟩

instance : AddCommMonoid Raw where
  zero := zero
  add := add
  zero_add := by intro p; change add zero p = p; apply ext <;> simp [add, zero]
  add_zero := by intro p; change add p zero = p; apply ext <;> simp [add, zero]
  add_assoc := by
    intro p q r
    change add (add p q) r = add p (add q r)
    apply ext <;> simp [add, Nat.add_assoc]
  add_comm := by
    intro p q
    change add p q = add q p
    apply ext <;> simp [add, Nat.add_comm]
  nsmul := nsmulRec
  nsmul_zero := by intro p; rfl
  nsmul_succ := by intro n p; rfl

@[simp] theorem add_x (p q : Raw) : (p + q).x = p.x + q.x := rfl
@[simp] theorem add_y (p q : Raw) : (p + q).y = p.y + q.y := rfl
@[simp] theorem add_z (p q : Raw) : (p + q).z = p.z + q.z := rfl

end Raw

/-- Natural-exponent normal forms for the relation `x^a = y^b z^c`. -/
structure Normal (a b c : ℕ) where
  x : ℕ
  y : ℕ
  z : ℕ
  x_lt : x < a
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

namespace Normal

variable {a b c : ℕ}

@[ext] theorem ext {p q : Normal a b c}
    (hx : p.x = q.x) (hy : p.y = q.y) (hz : p.z = q.z) : p = q := by
  cases p
  cases q
  simp_all

def raw (p : Normal a b c) : Raw := ⟨p.x, p.y, p.z⟩

private theorem positive (a : ℕ) [NeZero a] : 0 < a :=
  Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne a)

/-- Normalize a natural exponent triple by repeatedly replacing `x^a` by `y^b z^c`. -/
def normalize (a b c : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (p : Raw) : Normal a b c where
  x := p.x % a
  y := p.y + (p.x / a) * b
  z := p.z + (p.x / a) * c
  x_lt := Nat.mod_lt _ ha

@[simp] theorem normalize_x (ha : 0 < a) (p : Raw) :
    (normalize a b c ha p).x = p.x % a := rfl

@[simp] theorem normalize_y (ha : 0 < a) (p : Raw) :
    (normalize a b c ha p).y = p.y + (p.x / a) * b := rfl

@[simp] theorem normalize_z (ha : 0 < a) (p : Raw) :
    (normalize a b c ha p).z = p.z + (p.x / a) * c := rfl

@[simp] theorem normalize_raw (ha : 0 < a) (p : Normal a b c) :
    normalize a b c ha p.raw = p := by
  ext <;> simp [normalize, raw, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt p.x_lt, Nat.div_eq_of_lt p.x_lt]

private theorem div_normalize_add (ha : 0 < a) (m n : ℕ) :
    m / a + (m % a + n) / a = (m + n) / a := by
  simp only [Nat.add_div ha]
  have hm : m % a < a := Nat.mod_lt _ ha
  simp [Nat.div_eq_of_lt hm, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hm, Nat.add_assoc]

/-- Normalizing the left summand before adding does not change the result. -/
theorem normalize_normalize_add (ha : 0 < a) (p q : Raw) :
    normalize a b c ha ((normalize a b c ha p).raw + q) =
      normalize a b c ha (p + q) := by
  apply Normal.ext
  · simp [normalize, raw, Nat.add_mod]
  · change (p.y + p.x / a * b + q.y) + (p.x % a + q.x) / a * b =
      p.y + q.y + (p.x + q.x) / a * b
    have hdiv := div_normalize_add (a := a) ha p.x q.x
    rw [← hdiv]
    simp only [Nat.add_mul]
    omega
  · change (p.z + p.x / a * c + q.z) + (p.x % a + q.x) / a * c =
      p.z + q.z + (p.x + q.x) / a * c
    have hdiv := div_normalize_add (a := a) ha p.x q.x
    rw [← hdiv]
    simp only [Nat.add_mul]
    omega

/-- Multiplication of normal forms is addition of exponents followed by normalization. -/
def mul [NeZero a] (p q : Normal a b c) : Normal a b c :=
  normalize a b c (positive a) (p.raw + q.raw)

def one [NeZero a] : Normal a b c := ⟨0, 0, 0, positive a⟩

instance [NeZero a] : CommMonoid (Normal a b c) where
  mul := mul
  one := one
  mul_assoc p q r := by
    change normalize a b c (positive a)
        ((normalize a b c (positive a) (p.raw + q.raw)).raw + r.raw) =
      normalize a b c (positive a)
        (p.raw + (normalize a b c (positive a) (q.raw + r.raw)).raw)
    rw [normalize_normalize_add]
    rw [show p.raw + (normalize a b c (positive a) (q.raw + r.raw)).raw =
        (normalize a b c (positive a) (q.raw + r.raw)).raw + p.raw by rw [add_comm]]
    rw [normalize_normalize_add]
    congr 1
    apply Raw.ext <;> simp [Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm]
  one_mul p := by
    change normalize a b c (positive a) ((one (a := a) (b := b) (c := c)).raw + p.raw) = p
    rw [show (one (a := a) (b := b) (c := c)).raw + p.raw = p.raw by
      apply Raw.ext <;> simp [one, raw]]
    exact normalize_raw (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) (positive a) p
  mul_one p := by
    change normalize a b c (positive a) (p.raw + (one (a := a) (b := b) (c := c)).raw) = p
    rw [show p.raw + (one (a := a) (b := b) (c := c)).raw = p.raw by
      apply Raw.ext <;> simp [one, raw]]
    exact normalize_raw (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) (positive a) p
  mul_comm p q := by
    change normalize a b c (positive a) (p.raw + q.raw) =
      normalize a b c (positive a) (q.raw + p.raw)
    rw [add_comm]

@[simp] theorem one_x [NeZero a] : (1 : Normal a b c).x = 0 := rfl
@[simp] theorem one_y [NeZero a] : (1 : Normal a b c).y = 0 := rfl
@[simp] theorem one_z [NeZero a] : (1 : Normal a b c).z = 0 := rfl

@[simp] theorem mul_x [NeZero a] (p q : Normal a b c) :
    (p * q).x = (p.x + q.x) % a := rfl

@[simp] theorem mul_y [NeZero a] (p q : Normal a b c) :
    (p * q).y = p.y + q.y + ((p.x + q.x) / a) * b := rfl

@[simp] theorem mul_z [NeZero a] (p q : Normal a b c) :
    (p * q).z = p.z + q.z + ((p.x + q.x) / a) * c := rfl

/-- Left multiplication is injective in the normalized one-tie monoid. -/
theorem mul_left_cancel [NeZero a] {p q r : Normal a b c}
    (h : p * q = p * r) : q = r := by
  have hmod : Nat.ModEq a (p.x + q.x) (p.x + r.x) := congrArg Normal.x h
  have hqr : Nat.ModEq a q.x r.x := Nat.ModEq.add_left_cancel' p.x hmod
  have hx : q.x = r.x := by
    unfold Nat.ModEq at hqr
    simpa [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt q.x_lt, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt r.x_lt] using hqr
  have hy := congrArg Normal.y h
  have hz := congrArg Normal.z h
  apply Normal.ext hx
  · simp only [mul_y] at hy
    rw [hx] at hy
    omega
  · simp only [mul_z] at hz
    rw [hx] at hz
    omega

/-- Right multiplication is injective in the normalized one-tie monoid. -/
theorem mul_right_cancel [NeZero a] {p q r : Normal a b c}
    (h : q * p = r * p) : q = r := by
  rw [mul_comm q p, mul_comm r p] at h
  exact mul_left_cancel h

instance [NeZero a] : IsCancelMul (Normal a b c) where
  mul_left_cancel := fun _ _ _ h => mul_left_cancel h
  mul_right_cancel := fun _ _ _ h => mul_right_cancel h

/-- Normalization is idempotent after forgetting a normal form to raw exponents. -/
theorem normalize_idempotent [NeZero a] (p : Raw) :
    normalize a b c (positive a) (normalize a b c (positive a) p).raw =
      normalize a b c (positive a) p :=
  normalize_raw _ _

end Normal

end P23.OneTie

  cases p
  cases q
  simp_all

def raw (p : Normal a b c) : Raw := ⟨p.x, p.y, p.z⟩

  Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne a)

def normalize (a b c : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (p : Raw) : Normal a b c where
  x := p.x % a
  y := p.y + (p.x / a) * b
  z := p.z + (p.x / a) * c
  x_lt := Nat.mod_lt _ ha

    (normalize a b c ha p).x = p.x % a := rfl

@[simp] theorem normalize_y (ha : 0 < a) (p : Raw) :
    (normalize a b c ha p).y = p.y + (p.x / a) * b := rfl

    (normalize a b c ha p).z = p.z + (p.x / a) * c := rfl

    normalize a b c ha p.raw = p := by
  ext <;> simp [normalize, raw, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt p.x_lt, Nat.div_eq_of_lt p.x_lt]

    m / a + (m % a + n) / a = (m + n) / a := by
  simp only [Nat.add_div ha]
  have hm : m % a < a := Nat.mod_lt _ ha
  simp [Nat.div_eq_of_lt hm, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hm, Nat.add_assoc]

theorem normalize_normalize_add (ha : 0 < a) (p q : Raw) :
    normalize a b c ha ((normalize a b c ha p).raw + q) =
      normalize a b c ha (p + q) := by
  apply Normal.ext
  · simp [normalize, raw, Nat.add_mod]
  · change (p.y + p.x / a * b + q.y) + (p.x % a + q.x) / a * b =
      p.y + q.y + (p.x + q.x) / a * b
    have hdiv := div_normalize_add (a := a) ha p.x q.x
    rw [← hdiv]
    simp only [Nat.add_mul]

  · change (p.z + p.x / a * c + q.z) + (p.x % a + q.x) / a * c =
      p.z + q.z + (p.x + q.x) / a * c
    have hdiv := div_normalize_add (a := a) ha p.x q.x
    rw [← hdiv]
    simp only [Nat.add_mul]

    change normalize a b c (positive a) (p.raw + (one (a := a) (b := b) (c := c)).raw) = p
    rw [show p.raw + (one (a := a) (b := b) (c := c)).raw = p.raw by
      apply Raw.ext <;> simp [one, raw]]
    exact normalize_raw (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) (positive a) p
  mul_comm p q := by
    change normalize a b c (positive a) (p.raw + q.raw) =
      normalize a b c (positive a) (q.raw + p.raw)
    rw [add_comm]

    (p * q).x = (p.x + q.x) % a := rfl

@[simp] theorem mul_y [NeZero a] (p q : Normal a b c) :
    (p * q).y = p.y + q.y + ((p.x + q.x) / a) * b := rfl

theorem mul_left_cancel [NeZero a] {p q r : Normal a b c}

  have hmod : Nat.ModEq a (p.x + q.x) (p.x + r.x) := congrArg Normal.x h
  have hqr : Nat.ModEq a q.x r.x := Nat.ModEq.add_left_cancel' p.x hmod
  have hx : q.x = r.x := by
    unfold Nat.ModEq at hqr
    simpa [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt q.x_lt, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt r.x_lt] using hqr
  have hy := congrArg Normal.y h
  have hz := congrArg Normal.z h
  apply Normal.ext hx
  · simp only [mul_y] at hy

    omega
  · simp only [mul_z] at hz
    rw [hx] at hz
    omega

theorem mul_right_cancel [NeZero a] {p q r : Normal a b c}

  rw [mul_comm q p, mul_comm r p] at h
  exact mul_left_cancel h

  mul_left_cancel := fun _ _ _ h => mul_left_cancel h
  mul_right_cancel := fun _ _ _ h => mul_right_cancel h

theorem normalize_idempotent [NeZero a] (p : Raw) :
    normalize a b c (positive a) (normalize a b c (positive a) p).raw =
      normalize a b c (positive a) p :=
  normalize_raw _ _

end Normal

end P23.OneTie

/-- Weighted degree for an ordered family of four natural generators. -/
def weightedDegreeOf (n : Fin 4 → ℕ) (u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ∑ j : Fin 4, u j * n j

@[simp] theorem weightedDegreeOf_zero (n : Fin 4 → ℕ) :
    weightedDegreeOf n 0 = 0 := by simp [weightedDegreeOf]

theorem weightedDegreeOf_add (n : Fin 4 → ℕ) (u v : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) :
    weightedDegreeOf n (u + v) = weightedDegreeOf n u + weightedDegreeOf n v := by
  simp [weightedDegreeOf, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

/-- The additive weighted-degree homomorphism. -/
def weightedDegreeHomOf (n : Fin 4 → ℕ) : (Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) →+ ℕ where
  toFun := weightedDegreeOf n
  map_zero' := weightedDegreeOf_zero n
  map_add' := weightedDegreeOf_add n

/-- The additive submonoid generated by the ordered family. -/
def generatedByFour (n : Fin 4 → ℕ) : AddSubmonoid ℕ :=
  AddMonoidHom.mrange (weightedDegreeHomOf n)

/-- Ordered, positive, minimal four-generator data whose generated submonoid
has finite complement in `ℕ`. -/
structure FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup where
  n : Fin 4 → ℕ
  positive : ∀ j, 0 < n j
  injective : Function.Injective n
  minimal : ∀ j (u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ), u j = 0 → weightedDegreeOf n u ≠ n j
  cofinite : Set.Finite {s : ℕ | s ∉ generatedByFour n}

namespace FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup

variable (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup)

abbrev weightedDegree (u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) : ℕ := weightedDegreeOf D.n u

/-- The numerical semigroup generated by the four ordered generators. -/
abbrev Gamma : AddSubmonoid ℕ := generatedByFour D.n

theorem mem_Gamma_iff (s : ℕ) :
    s ∈ D.Gamma ↔ ∃ u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ, D.weightedDegree u = s := by
  exact AddMonoidHom.mem_mrange

def generatorFactorization (j : Fin 4) : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ := Finsupp.single j 1

    D.weightedDegree (generatorFactorization j) = D.n j := by
  classical
  simp only [weightedDegreeOf, generatorFactorization]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
  · simp
  · intro b _ hbj

  have hone : 1 ≤ D.n j := D.positive j
  simpa only [Nat.mul_one] using (Nat.mul_le_mul_left (u j) hone).trans hterm

theorem factorization_coordinate_le {s : ℕ} (u : D.Factorization s) (j : Fin 4) :
    u.1 j ≤ s := by
  simpa [u.2] using D.coordinate_le_weightedDegree u.1 j

instance factorizationFinite (s : ℕ) : Finite (D.Factorization s) := by
  let f : D.Factorization s → (Fin 4 → Fin (s + 1)) := fun u j =>
    ⟨u.1 j, Nat.lt_succ_of_le (D.factorization_coordinate_le u j)⟩
  exact Finite.of_injective f (by
    intro u v h
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Finsupp.ext
    intro j
    exact congrArg (fun g => (g j : ℕ)) h)

/-- The finite set of all exponent vectors of a fixed semigroup degree. -/
def factorizations (s : ℕ) : Finset (Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) :=
  letI := Fintype.ofFinite (D.Factorization s)
  Finset.univ.image (fun u : D.Factorization s => u.1)

@[simp] theorem mem_factorizations {s : ℕ} {u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ} :
    u ∈ D.factorizations s ↔ D.weightedDegree u = s := by
  classical
  simp [factorizations]

/-- The selected base generator. -/
def base (i : Fin 4) : D.Gamma := D.generator i

/-- The exact embedding of the three tail indices into the four indices. -/
def tailIndex (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup) (i : Fin 4) : Fin 3 ↪ Fin 4 :=
  i.succAboveEmb

@[simp] theorem tailIndex_apply (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) :
    D.tailIndex i j = i.succAbove j := rfl

theorem tailIndex_ne_base (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) : D.tailIndex i j ≠ i := by
  simpa [tailIndex] using Fin.succAbove_ne i j

theorem tailIndex_injective (i : Fin 4) : Function.Injective (D.tailIndex i) :=
  (D.tailIndex i).injective

/-- The three generators other than the selected base. -/
def tailGen (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) : ℕ := D.n (D.tailIndex i j)

theorem tailGen_positive (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) : 0 < D.tailGen i j :=
  D.positive _

theorem tailGen_injective (i : Fin 4) : Function.Injective (D.tailGen i) :=
  D.injective.comp (D.tailIndex_injective i)

theorem tailGen_ne_base (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) : D.tailGen i j ≠ D.n i := by
  exact fun h => D.tailIndex_ne_base i j (D.injective h)

/-- Tail generator as a semigroup element. -/
def tail (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) : D.Gamma := D.generator (D.tailIndex i j)

/-- Apéry membership is absence of an additive predecessor by the selected
base.  This definition deliberately avoids truncated subtraction. -/
def IsApery (i : Fin 4) (s : D.Gamma) : Prop :=
  ¬ ∃ h : D.Gamma, s = D.base i + h

theorem zero_isApery (i : Fin 4) : D.IsApery i 0 := by
  rintro ⟨h, hh⟩
  have := congrArg Subtype.val hh
  have hq := D.positive i
  simp only [AddSubmonoid.coe_zero, AddSubmonoid.coe_add, base, generator] at this
  omega

theorem base_not_isApery (i : Fin 4) : ¬ D.IsApery i (D.base i) := by
  refine fun h => h ⟨0, ?_⟩
  simp

private theorem weighted_term_le (u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) (j : Fin 4) :
    u j * D.n j ≤ D.weightedDegree u := by
  apply Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ j)

theorem tail_isApery (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) : D.IsApery i (D.tail i j) := by
  rintro ⟨h, hh⟩
  rcases (D.mem_Gamma_iff h.1).1 h.2 with ⟨u, hu⟩
  let tj : Fin 4 := D.tailIndex i j
  have heq : D.n tj = D.n i + D.weightedDegree u := by
    have hraw := congrArg Subtype.val hh
    have hraw' : D.n tj = D.n i + h.1 := by
      simpa [tj, tail, generator, base] using hraw
    rw [hraw', hu]
  have hut : u tj = 0 := by
    by_contra hne
    have hone : 1 ≤ u tj := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 hne
    have hterm := D.weighted_term_le u tj
    have hmul : D.n tj ≤ u tj * D.n tj := by
      simpa [one_mul] using Nat.mul_le_mul_right (D.n tj) hone
    have hni := D.positive i
    omega
  let v : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ := Finsupp.single i 1 + u
  have hvzero : v tj = 0 := by
    have hit : i ≠ tj := (D.tailIndex_ne_base i j).symm
    simp [v, Finsupp.single_apply, hit, hut]
  have hsingle : weightedDegreeOf D.n (Finsupp.single i 1) = D.n i := by
    simpa [generatorFactorization] using D.weightedDegree_generatorFactorization i
  have hvdeg : D.weightedDegree v = D.n tj := by
    change weightedDegreeOf D.n v = D.n tj
    rw [show v = Finsupp.single i 1 + u by rfl, weightedDegreeOf_add, hsingle]
    exact heq.symm
  exact (D.minimal tj v hvzero) hvdeg

/-- The finite set of gaps of the generated semigroup. -/
def gapFinset : Finset ℕ := D.cofinite.toFinset

@[simp] theorem mem_gapFinset (s : ℕ) : s ∈ D.gapFinset ↔ s ∉ D.Gamma := by
  simp [gapFinset]

/-- A concrete conductor bound extracted from cofiniteness. -/
def conductor : ℕ := D.gapFinset.sup id + 1

theorem mem_Gamma_of_conductor_le {s : ℕ} (hs : D.conductor ≤ s) : s ∈ D.Gamma := by
  by_contra hnot
  have hmem : s ∈ D.gapFinset := (D.mem_gapFinset s).2 hnot
  have hle : s ≤ D.gapFinset.sup id := Finset.le_sup (f := id) hmem
  simp [conductor] at hs
  omega

theorem isApery_lt (i : Fin 4) {s : D.Gamma} (hs : D.IsApery i s) :
    s.1 < D.conductor + D.n i := by
  by_contra hnot
  have hqi : D.n i ≤ s.1 := by
    have hc : D.conductor ≤ s.1 := by omega
    have hq := D.positive i
    omega
  let d : ℕ := s.1 - D.n i
  have hdcond : D.conductor ≤ d := by omega
  have hdmem : d ∈ D.Gamma := D.mem_Gamma_of_conductor_le hdcond
  apply hs
  refine ⟨⟨d, hdmem⟩, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp [base, generator, d, Nat.add_sub_of_le hqi]

/-- The finite subtype indexing the Apéry basis. -/
abbrev AperyIndex (i : Fin 4) := {s : D.Gamma // D.IsApery i s}

instance aperyIndexFinite (i : Fin 4) : Finite (D.AperyIndex i) := by
  let f : D.AperyIndex i → Fin (D.conductor + D.n i) := fun s =>
    ⟨s.1.1, D.isApery_lt i s.2⟩
  exact Finite.of_injective f (by
    intro s t h
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact congrArg Fin.val h)

/-- Exact finite Apéry set inside the semigroup subtype. -/
def aperyFinset (i : Fin 4) : Finset D.Gamma :=
  letI := Fintype.ofFinite (D.AperyIndex i)
  Finset.univ.map
    (⟨fun s : D.AperyIndex i => s.1, Subtype.val_injective⟩ :
      D.AperyIndex i ↪ D.Gamma)

@[simp] theorem mem_aperyFinset (i : Fin 4) (s : D.Gamma) :
    s ∈ D.aperyFinset i ↔ D.IsApery i s := by
  classical
  simp [aperyFinset]

theorem zero_mem_aperyFinset (i : Fin 4) : 0 ∈ D.aperyFinset i := by
  simpa using D.zero_isApery i

theorem base_not_mem_aperyFinset (i : Fin 4) : D.base i ∉ D.aperyFinset i := by
  simpa using D.base_not_isApery i

theorem tail_mem_aperyFinset (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) :
    D.tail i j ∈ D.aperyFinset i := by
  simpa using D.tail_isApery i j

/-- Any factorization of an Apéry degree has zero coordinate at the chosen
base.  This is the symbolic bridge used by the tail presentation; no
factorization uniqueness is asserted. -/
theorem apery_factorization_base_eq_zero (i : Fin 4) {s : D.Gamma}
    (hs : D.IsApery i s) (u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) (hu : D.weightedDegree u = s.1) :
    u i = 0 := by
  by_contra hnonzero
  have hui : 0 < u i := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hnonzero
  let v : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ := Finsupp.single i (u i - 1) + u.erase i
  have huv : u = Finsupp.single i 1 + v := by
    apply Finsupp.ext
    intro j
    by_cases hji : j = i
    · subst j
      simp [v]
      omega
    · simp [v, Finsupp.single_apply, hji]
  have hvGamma : D.weightedDegree v ∈ D.Gamma :=
    (D.mem_Gamma_iff _).2 ⟨v, rfl⟩
  apply hs
  refine ⟨⟨D.weightedDegree v, hvGamma⟩, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hsingle : D.weightedDegree (Finsupp.single i 1) = D.n i := by
    simpa [generatorFactorization] using D.weightedDegree_generatorFactorization i
  rw [← hu, huv]
  change weightedDegreeOf D.n (Finsupp.single i 1 + v) =
    D.n i + weightedDegreeOf D.n v
  change weightedDegreeOf D.n (Finsupp.single i 1) = D.n i at hsingle
  rw [weightedDegreeOf_add, hsingle]

end FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup

end

namespace P23.Semigroup

noncomputable section

open FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup

variable {k : Type*} [Field k]
variable (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup) (i : Fin 4)

/-- Genuine semigroup algebra on the generated additive submonoid. -/
abbrev SemigroupAlgebra := AddMonoidAlgebra k D.Gamma

/-- Canonical semigroup monomial. -/
def T (s : D.Gamma) : SemigroupAlgebra (k := k) D :=
  AddMonoidAlgebra.single s 1

@[simp] theorem T_zero : T (k := k) D 0 = 1 := by
  rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.one_def]
  rfl

@[simp] theorem T_add (s t : D.Gamma) :
    T (k := k) D s * T (k := k) D t = T (k := k) D (s + t) := by
  simp [T, AddMonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single]

/-- Principal ideal generated by the selected base monomial. -/
def baseMonomialIdeal : Ideal (SemigroupAlgebra (k := k) D) :=
  Ideal.span {T (k := k) D (D.base i)}

/-- The actual quotient `k[Gamma]/(t^q)`. -/
abbrev ChosenBaseQuotient :=
  SemigroupAlgebra (k := k) D ⧸ baseMonomialIdeal (k := k) D i

/-- Direct finite coordinate model on the Apéry set. -/
structure AperyArtin (k : Type*) [Field k]
    (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup) (i : Fin 4) where
  coeff : D.AperyIndex i →₀ k

namespace AperyArtin

variable {D i}

local instance (s : D.Gamma) : Decidable (D.IsApery i s) :=
  Classical.propDecidable _

def coeffEquiv : AperyArtin k D i ≃ (D.AperyIndex i →₀ k) where
  toFun := coeff
  invFun := AperyArtin.mk
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

instance : AddCommGroup (AperyArtin k D i) :=
  (coeffEquiv (k := k) (D := D) (i := i)).addCommGroup

def coeffAddEquiv : AperyArtin k D i ≃+ (D.AperyIndex i →₀ k) :=
  (coeffEquiv (k := k) (D := D) (i := i)).addEquiv

instance : Module k (AperyArtin k D i) :=
  (coeffAddEquiv (k := k) (D := D) (i := i)).module k

def coeffLinearEquiv : AperyArtin k D i ≃ₗ[k] (D.AperyIndex i →₀ k) :=
  (coeffAddEquiv (k := k) (D := D) (i := i)).linearEquiv k

@[ext] theorem ext {x y : AperyArtin k D i} (h : x.coeff = y.coeff) : x = y :=
  (coeffEquiv (k := k) (D := D) (i := i)).injective h

@[simp] theorem coeff_zero : coeff (0 : AperyArtin k D i) = 0 := rfl
@[simp] theorem coeff_add (x y : AperyArtin k D i) : coeff (x + y) = coeff x + coeff y := rfl
@[simp] theorem coeff_neg (x : AperyArtin k D i) : coeff (-x) = -coeff x := rfl
@[simp] theorem coeff_smul (r : k) (x : AperyArtin k D i) : coeff (r • x) = r • coeff x := rfl

@[elab_as_elim]
theorem induction_linear {P : AperyArtin k D i → Prop} (x : AperyArtin k D i)
    (zero : P 0) (add : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x + y))
    (single : ∀ p r, P (.mk (Finsupp.single p r))) : P x := by
  change P (.mk x.coeff)
  induction x.coeff using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => exact zero
  | add x y hx hy => exact add (.mk x) (.mk y) hx hy
  | single p r => exact single p r

/-- An Apéry basis vector. -/
def A (s : D.Gamma) (hs : D.IsApery i s) : AperyArtin k D i :=
  .mk (Finsupp.single ⟨s, hs⟩ 1)

@[simp] theorem coeff_A (s : D.Gamma) (hs : D.IsApery i s) (t : D.AperyIndex i) :
    (A (k := k) s hs).coeff t = if t.1 = s then 1 else 0 := by
  classical
  change (Finsupp.single ⟨s, hs⟩ 1) t = if t.1 = s then 1 else 0
  by_cases h : t.1 = s
  · have heq : t = (⟨s, hs⟩ : D.AperyIndex i) := Subtype.ext h
    simp [h, heq, Finsupp.single_apply]
  · have hne : t ≠ (⟨s, hs⟩ : D.AperyIndex i) := fun heq => h (congrArg Subtype.val heq)
    simp [h, hne, Finsupp.single_apply]

@[simp] theorem smul_A (r : k) (s : D.Gamma) (hs : D.IsApery i s) :
    r • A (k := k) s hs = .mk (Finsupp.single ⟨s, hs⟩ r) := by
  ext
  simp [A, Finsupp.single_apply]

theorem isApery_of_add_left {s t : D.Gamma} (h : D.IsApery i (s + t)) :
    D.IsApery i s := by
  intro hs
  rcases hs with ⟨u, hu⟩
  apply h
  refine ⟨u + t, ?_⟩
  rw [hu, add_assoc]

theorem isApery_of_add_right {s t : D.Gamma} (h : D.IsApery i (s + t)) :
    D.IsApery i t := by
  rw [add_comm] at h
  exact isApery_of_add_left h

noncomputable def basisProduct (s t : D.AperyIndex i) : AperyArtin k D i :=
  by
    classical
    exact if h : D.IsApery i (s.1 + t.1) then A (k := k) (s.1 + t.1) h else 0

def mul (x y : AperyArtin k D i) : AperyArtin k D i :=
  x.coeff.sum fun s rs => y.coeff.sum fun t rt =>
    (rs * rt) • basisProduct (k := k) s t

instance : Mul (AperyArtin k D i) := ⟨mul⟩

theorem mul_def (x y : AperyArtin k D i) :
    x * y = x.coeff.sum fun s rs => y.coeff.sum fun t rt =>
      (rs * rt) • basisProduct (k := k) s t := rfl

instance : NonUnitalNonAssocRing (AperyArtin k D i) where
  zero_mul := by simp [mul_def]
  mul_zero := by simp [mul_def]
  left_distrib := by
    classical
    intro x y z
    simp only [mul_def, coeff_add]
    rw [← Finsupp.sum_add]
    apply Finsupp.sum_congr
    intro p _
    rw [Finsupp.sum_add_index']
    · simp
    · intro q rq sq
      simp [mul_add, add_smul]
  right_distrib := by
    classical
    intro x y z
    simp only [mul_def, coeff_add]
    rw [Finsupp.sum_add_index']
    · simp
    · intro p rp sp
      simp [add_mul, add_smul, Finsupp.sum_add]

@[simp] theorem A_mul_A (s t : D.Gamma) (hs : D.IsApery i s) (ht : D.IsApery i t) :
    A (k := k) s hs * A (k := k) t ht =
      if h : D.IsApery i (s + t) then A (k := k) (s + t) h else 0 := by
  classical
  simp [mul_def, A, basisProduct]

theorem smul_mul_raw (r : k) (x y : AperyArtin k D i) : (r • x) * y = r • (x * y) := by
  classical
  simp only [mul_def, coeff_smul]
  rw [Finsupp.sum_smul_index (h0 := by simp), Finsupp.smul_sum]
  apply Finsupp.sum_congr
  intro p _
  rw [Finsupp.smul_sum]
  apply Finsupp.sum_congr
  intro q _
  rw [smul_smul]
  congr 1
  ring

theorem mul_smul_raw (r : k) (x y : AperyArtin k D i) : x * (r • y) = r • (x * y) := by
  classical
  simp only [mul_def, coeff_smul]
  rw [Finsupp.smul_sum]
  apply Finsupp.sum_congr
  intro p _
  rw [Finsupp.sum_smul_index (h0 := by simp), Finsupp.smul_sum]
  apply Finsupp.sum_congr
  intro q _
  rw [smul_smul]
  congr 1
  ring

private theorem A_assoc (s t u : D.AperyIndex i) :
    (A (k := k) s.1 s.2 * A (k := k) t.1 t.2) * A (k := k) u.1 u.2 =
      A (k := k) s.1 s.2 * (A (k := k) t.1 t.2 * A (k := k) u.1 u.2) := by
  classical
  by_cases htotal : D.IsApery i ((s.1 + t.1) + u.1)
  · have hst := isApery_of_add_left htotal
    have htu : D.IsApery i (t.1 + u.1) := by
      apply isApery_of_add_right (s := s.1)
      simpa [add_assoc] using htotal
    simp [A_mul_A, hst, htu, htotal, add_assoc]
  · have htotal' : ¬ D.IsApery i (s.1 + (t.1 + u.1)) := by simpa [add_assoc] using htotal
    by_cases hst : D.IsApery i (s.1 + t.1) <;>
      by_cases htu : D.IsApery i (t.1 + u.1) <;>
      simp [A_mul_A, hst, htu, htotal, htotal', add_assoc]

private theorem A_comm (s t : D.AperyIndex i) :
    A (k := k) s.1 s.2 * A (k := k) t.1 t.2 =
      A (k := k) t.1 t.2 * A (k := k) s.1 s.2 := by
  classical
  simp [A_mul_A, add_comm]

instance : NonUnitalRing (AperyArtin k D i) where
  mul_assoc := by
    classical
    intro x y z
    induction x using induction_linear with
    | zero => simp
    | add x₁ x₂ hx₁ hx₂ => simp [hx₁, hx₂, add_mul]
    | single s rs =>
      induction y using induction_linear with
      | zero => simp
      | add y₁ y₂ hy₁ hy₂ => simp [hy₁, hy₂, mul_add, add_mul]
      | single t rt =>
        induction z using induction_linear with
        | zero => simp
        | add z₁ z₂ hz₁ hz₂ => simp [hz₁, hz₂, mul_add, add_mul]
        | single u ru =>
          rw [← smul_A rs, ← smul_A rt, ← smul_A ru]
          simp only [smul_mul_raw, mul_smul_raw, smul_smul]
          convert congrArg (fun w : AperyArtin k D i => (rs * rt * ru) • w)
            (A_assoc (k := k) s t u) using 1 <;> ring_nf

instance : NonUnitalCommRing (AperyArtin k D i) where
  mul_comm := by
    classical
    intro x y
    induction x using induction_linear with
    | zero => simp
    | add x₁ x₂ hx₁ hx₂ => simp [hx₁, hx₂, add_mul, mul_add]
    | single s rs =>
      induction y using induction_linear with
      | zero => simp
      | add y₁ y₂ hy₁ hy₂ => simp [hy₁, hy₂, add_mul, mul_add]
      | single t rt =>
        rw [← smul_A rs, ← smul_A rt]
        simp only [smul_mul_raw, mul_smul_raw, smul_smul]
        rw [mul_comm rs rt, A_comm]

def one : AperyArtin k D i := A (k := k) 0 (D.zero_isApery i)
instance : One (AperyArtin k D i) := ⟨one (k := k)⟩

private theorem one_mul_A (s : D.AperyIndex i) :
    (1 : AperyArtin k D i) * A (k := k) s.1 s.2 = A (k := k) s.1 s.2 := by
  change A (k := k) 0 (D.zero_isApery i) * A (k := k) s.1 s.2 = _
  rw [A_mul_A]
  simp only [zero_add, dif_pos s.2]

private theorem A_mul_one (s : D.AperyIndex i) :
    A (k := k) s.1 s.2 * (1 : AperyArtin k D i) = A (k := k) s.1 s.2 := by
  change A (k := k) s.1 s.2 * A (k := k) 0 (D.zero_isApery i) = _
  calc
    _ = A (k := k) 0 (D.zero_isApery i) * A (k := k) s.1 s.2 :=
      A_comm (k := k) s ⟨0, D.zero_isApery i⟩
    _ = _ := one_mul_A (k := k) s

instance : NonAssocRing (AperyArtin k D i) where
  natCast n := n • (1 : AperyArtin k D i)
  natCast_zero := by simp
  natCast_succ n := by change (n + 1) • (1 : AperyArtin k D i) = n • 1 + 1; simp [add_nsmul]
  intCast z := match z with | .ofNat n => n • (1 : AperyArtin k D i) | .negSucc n => -((n+1) • 1)
  intCast_ofNat _ := rfl
  intCast_negSucc _ := rfl
  one_mul := by
    classical
    intro x
    induction x using induction_linear with
    | zero => simp
    | add x y hx hy => simp [mul_add, hx, hy]
    | single s r => rw [← smul_A r, mul_smul_raw, one_mul_A]
  mul_one := by
    classical
    intro x
    induction x using induction_linear with
    | zero => simp
    | add x y hx hy => simp [add_mul, hx, hy]
    | single s r => rw [← smul_A r, smul_mul_raw, A_mul_one]

instance : Ring (AperyArtin k D i) where
instance : CommRing (AperyArtin k D i) where

instance : Algebra k (AperyArtin k D i) :=
  Algebra.ofModule smul_mul_raw mul_smul_raw

def aperyBasis : Module.Basis (D.AperyIndex i) k (AperyArtin k D i) :=
  Finsupp.basisSingleOne.map (coeffLinearEquiv (k := k) (D := D) (i := i)).symm

instance : FiniteDimensional k (AperyArtin k D i) :=
  (aperyBasis (k := k) (D := D) (i := i)).finiteDimensional_of_finite

end AperyArtin

open AperyArtin

/-- A semigroup monomial truncated to the Apéry basis. -/
noncomputable def truncatedAperyMonomial (s : D.Gamma) : AperyArtin k D i :=
  by
    classical
    exact if hs : D.IsApery i s then A (k := k) s hs else 0

@[simp] theorem truncatedAperyMonomial_zero :
    truncatedAperyMonomial (k := k) D i 0 = 1 := by
  classical
  change (if hs : D.IsApery i 0 then A (k := k) 0 hs else 0) =
    A (k := k) 0 (D.zero_isApery i)
  simp only [dif_pos (D.zero_isApery i)]

@[simp] theorem truncatedAperyMonomial_add (s t : D.Gamma) :
    truncatedAperyMonomial (k := k) D i (s + t) =
      truncatedAperyMonomial (k := k) D i s * truncatedAperyMonomial (k := k) D i t := by
  classical
  by_cases hst : D.IsApery i (s + t)
  · have hs := AperyArtin.isApery_of_add_left hst
    have ht := AperyArtin.isApery_of_add_right hst
    simp [truncatedAperyMonomial, hst, hs, ht, A_mul_A]
  · by_cases hs : D.IsApery i s <;> by_cases ht : D.IsApery i t <;>
      simp [truncatedAperyMonomial, hst, hs, ht, A_mul_A]

def truncatedAperyMonomialHom : Multiplicative D.Gamma →* AperyArtin k D i where
  toFun s := truncatedAperyMonomial (k := k) D i s.toAdd
  map_one' := truncatedAperyMonomial_zero (k := k) D i
  map_mul' s t := by simpa using truncatedAperyMonomial_add (k := k) D i s.toAdd t.toAdd

/-- Natural algebra hom from the genuine semigroup algebra to the finite
Apéry model. -/
def semigroupToAperyAlg : SemigroupAlgebra (k := k) D →ₐ[k] AperyArtin k D i :=
  AddMonoidAlgebra.lift k (AperyArtin k D i) D.Gamma
    (truncatedAperyMonomialHom (k := k) D i)

@[simp] theorem semigroupToAperyAlg_single (s : D.Gamma) (r : k) :
    semigroupToAperyAlg (k := k) D i (AddMonoidAlgebra.single s r) =
      r • truncatedAperyMonomial (k := k) D i s := by
  exact AddMonoidAlgebra.lift_single _ _ _

@[simp] theorem semigroupToAperyAlg_T (s : D.Gamma) :
    semigroupToAperyAlg (k := k) D i (T (k := k) D s) =
      truncatedAperyMonomial (k := k) D i s := by simp [T]

theorem semigroupToAperyAlg_surjective :
    Function.Surjective (semigroupToAperyAlg (k := k) D i) := by
  intro x
  induction x using AperyArtin.induction_linear with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
  | add x y hx hy =>
      rcases hx with ⟨fx, rfl⟩
      rcases hy with ⟨fy, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨fx + fy, by simp⟩
  | single s r =>
      refine ⟨AddMonoidAlgebra.single s.1 r, ?_⟩
      simp [truncatedAperyMonomial, s.2, AperyArtin.smul_A]

theorem coeff_semigroupToAperyAlg (f : SemigroupAlgebra (k := k) D)
    (s : D.AperyIndex i) :
    (semigroupToAperyAlg (k := k) D i f).coeff s = f.coeff s.1 := by
  classical
  induction f using AddMonoidAlgebra.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add f g hf hg => simp [hf, hg]
  | single t r =>
      by_cases ht : D.IsApery i t
      · by_cases hts : t = s.1
        · subst t; simp [truncatedAperyMonomial, ht]
        · have hne : (⟨t, ht⟩ : D.AperyIndex i) ≠ s := fun h => hts (congrArg Subtype.val h)
          simp [truncatedAperyMonomial, ht, hts, hne]
      · have hne : t ≠ s.1 := fun h => ht (h ▸ s.2)
        simp [truncatedAperyMonomial, ht, Finsupp.single_apply, hne]

theorem T_mem_baseMonomialIdeal (s : D.Gamma) (hs : ¬ D.IsApery i s) :
    T (k := k) D s ∈ baseMonomialIdeal (k := k) D i := by
  classical
  rcases not_not.mp hs with ⟨h, rfl⟩
  have hb : T (k := k) D (D.base i) ∈ baseMonomialIdeal (k := k) D i := by
    apply Ideal.subset_span
    simp
  rw [← T_add]
  exact (baseMonomialIdeal (k := k) D i).mul_mem_right (T (k := k) D h) hb

theorem baseMonomialIdeal_le_ker :
    baseMonomialIdeal (k := k) D i ≤ RingHom.ker (semigroupToAperyAlg (k := k) D i).toRingHom := by
  apply Ideal.span_le.2
  intro f hf
  simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hf
  subst f
  apply RingHom.mem_ker.2
  simp [truncatedAperyMonomial, D.base_not_isApery i]

theorem ker_le_baseMonomialIdeal :
    RingHom.ker (semigroupToAperyAlg (k := k) D i).toRingHom ≤ baseMonomialIdeal (k := k) D i := by
  intro f hf
  have hf0 : semigroupToAperyAlg (k := k) D i f = 0 := RingHom.mem_ker.1 hf
  rw [← AddMonoidAlgebra.sum_coeff_single f]
  apply Submodule.sum_mem
  intro s hsupp
  by_cases hs : D.IsApery i s
  · have hc := congrArg (fun x : AperyArtin k D i => x.coeff ⟨s, hs⟩) hf0
    have hz : f.coeff s = 0 := by simpa [coeff_semigroupToAperyAlg] using hc
    simp [hz]
  · have hm := T_mem_baseMonomialIdeal (k := k) D i s hs
    have hsmul := (baseMonomialIdeal (k := k) D i).mul_mem_left
      (algebraMap k (SemigroupAlgebra (k := k) D) (f.coeff s)) hm
    simpa [T, Algebra.smul_def] using hsmul

/-- Exact truncation kernel. -/
theorem semigroupToAperyAlg_ker :
    RingHom.ker (semigroupToAperyAlg (k := k) D i).toRingHom =
      baseMonomialIdeal (k := k) D i := by
  exact le_antisymm (ker_le_baseMonomialIdeal (k := k) D i)
    (baseMonomialIdeal_le_ker (k := k) D i)

/-- Genuine quotient/finite-Apéry algebra equivalence. -/
def chosenBaseEquivApery : ChosenBaseQuotient (k := k) D i ≃ₐ[k] AperyArtin k D i :=
  (Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq k (semigroupToAperyAlg_ker (k := k) D i).symm).trans
    (Ideal.quotientKerAlgEquivOfSurjective (semigroupToAperyAlg_surjective (k := k) D i))

@[simp] theorem chosenBaseEquivApery_mk (f : SemigroupAlgebra (k := k) D) :
    chosenBaseEquivApery (k := k) D i
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (baseMonomialIdeal (k := k) D i) f) =
      semigroupToAperyAlg (k := k) D i f := by rfl

end

end P23.Semigroup

-- [Emissary prelude] P23.Semigroup.ChosenBase — verbatim (imports stripped)
namespace P23.Semigroup

noncomputable section

open scoped BigOperators
open FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup AperyArtin

variable {k : Type*} [Field k]
variable (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup) (i : Fin 4)

/-- Three-variable polynomial ring attached to the three generators other
than the chosen base. -/
abbrev TailPoly (k : Type*) [CommSemiring k] := MvPolynomial (Fin 3) k

/-- Degree of a tail exponent vector in the numerical semigroup. -/
def tailDegree (u : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ∑ j : Fin 3, u j * D.tailGen i j

@[simp] theorem tailDegree_zero : tailDegree D i 0 = 0 := by
  simp [tailDegree]

theorem tailDegree_add (u v : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) :
    tailDegree D i (u + v) = tailDegree D i u + tailDegree D i v := by
  simp [tailDegree, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

@[simp] theorem tailDegree_single (j : Fin 3) (n : ℕ) :
    tailDegree D i (Finsupp.single j n) = n * D.tailGen i j := by
  classical
  simp [tailDegree, Finsupp.single_apply]

/-- Restriction of a four-generator factorization to the three tail
coordinates. -/
def tailExponent (u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ :=
  Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.symm (fun j => u (D.tailIndex i j))

@[simp] theorem tailExponent_apply (u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) (j : Fin 3) :
    tailExponent D i u j = u (D.tailIndex i j) := by
  simp [tailExponent]

theorem weightedDegree_eq_tailDegree_of_base_zero (u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ)
    (hu : u i = 0) :
    D.weightedDegree u = tailDegree D i (tailExponent D i u) := by
  change (∑ j : Fin 4, u j * D.n j) =
    ∑ j : Fin 3, u (i.succAbove j) * D.n (i.succAbove j)
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_succAbove _ i]
  simp [hu, tailDegree, tailExponent, FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.tailGen,
    FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.tailIndex]

/-- A tail exponent vector extended by zero at the selected base index. -/
def extendTailExponent (u : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ :=
  Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.symm
    (Fin.succAboveCases i (0 : ℕ) (fun j => u j))

@[simp] theorem extendTailExponent_base (u : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) :
    extendTailExponent i u i = 0 := by
  simp [extendTailExponent]

@[simp] theorem extendTailExponent_tail (u : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) (j : Fin 3) :
    extendTailExponent i u (i.succAbove j) = u j := by
  simp [extendTailExponent]

theorem weightedDegree_extendTailExponent (u : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) :
    D.weightedDegree (extendTailExponent i u) = tailDegree D i u := by
  rw [weightedDegree_eq_tailDegree_of_base_zero D i _ (extendTailExponent_base i u)]
  congr 1
  apply Finsupp.ext
  intro j
  simp [tailExponent, extendTailExponent]

/-- Semigroup degree represented by a tail exponent vector. -/
def tailDegreeGamma (u : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) : D.Gamma :=
  ⟨tailDegree D i u, (D.mem_Gamma_iff _).2
    ⟨extendTailExponent i u, weightedDegree_extendTailExponent D i u⟩⟩

@[simp] theorem tailDegreeGamma_zero : tailDegreeGamma D i 0 = 0 := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp [tailDegreeGamma]

theorem tailDegreeGamma_add (u v : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) :
    tailDegreeGamma D i (u + v) = tailDegreeGamma D i u + tailDegreeGamma D i v := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact tailDegree_add D i u v

/-- Tail variable in the finite Apéry algebra. -/
def tailVariableA (j : Fin 3) : AperyArtin k D i :=
  A (k := k) (D.tail i j) (D.tail_isApery i j)

@[simp] theorem truncatedAperyMonomial_tail (j : Fin 3) :
    truncatedAperyMonomial (k := k) D i (D.tail i j) =
      tailVariableA (k := k) D i j := by
  simp [truncatedAperyMonomial, tailVariableA, D.tail_isApery i j]

/-- Polynomial evaluation in the finite Apéry model. -/
def tailPolyToApery : TailPoly k →ₐ[k] AperyArtin k D i :=
  MvPolynomial.aeval (tailVariableA (k := k) D i)

/-- Polynomial evaluation in the genuine chosen-base quotient. -/
def tailPolyToChosenBase : TailPoly k →ₐ[k] ChosenBaseQuotient (k := k) D i :=
  (chosenBaseEquivApery (k := k) D i).symm.toAlgHom.comp
    (tailPolyToApery (k := k) D i)

@[simp] theorem tailPolyToApery_X (j : Fin 3) :
    tailPolyToApery (k := k) D i (MvPolynomial.X j) = tailVariableA (k := k) D i j := by
  simp [tailPolyToApery]

private theorem tailVariable_prod (u : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) :
    u.prod (fun j n => (tailVariableA (k := k) D i j) ^ n) =
      truncatedAperyMonomial (k := k) D i
        (tailDegreeGamma D i u) := by
  induction u using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add u v hu hv =>
      rw [Finsupp.prod_add_index' (fun _ => pow_zero _) (fun _ _ _ => pow_add _ _ _)]
      rw [hu, hv, ← truncatedAperyMonomial_add]
      congr 2
      exact (tailDegreeGamma_add D i u v).symm
  | single j n =>
      rw [Finsupp.prod_single_index]
      · induction n with
        | zero => simp
        | succ n hn =>
            rw [pow_succ, hn, ← truncatedAperyMonomial_tail,
              ← truncatedAperyMonomial_add]
            congr 2
            apply Subtype.ext
            simp only [AddSubmonoid.coe_add]
            change tailDegree D i (Finsupp.single j n) + D.tailGen i j =
              tailDegree D i (Finsupp.single j (n + 1))
            rw [tailDegree_single, tailDegree_single]
            simp [Nat.add_mul]
      · simp

/-- Exact arbitrary tail-monomial image. -/
@[simp] theorem tailPolyToApery_monomial (u : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) (r : k) :
    tailPolyToApery (k := k) D i (MvPolynomial.monomial u r) =
      r • truncatedAperyMonomial (k := k) D i
        (tailDegreeGamma D i u) := by
  rw [tailPolyToApery, MvPolynomial.aeval_monomial, tailVariable_prod]
  simp [Algebra.smul_def]

/-- Every Apéry degree has a tail-only factorization. -/
theorem exists_tailExponent_of_isApery {s : D.Gamma} (hs : D.IsApery i s) :
    ∃ u : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ, tailDegree D i u = s.1 := by
  rcases (D.mem_Gamma_iff s.1).1 s.2 with ⟨v, hv⟩
  have hvi := D.apery_factorization_base_eq_zero i hs v hv
  refine ⟨tailExponent D i v, ?_⟩
  rw [← weightedDegree_eq_tailDegree_of_base_zero D i v hvi, hv]

/-- Minimality of the original four generators says that the only tail
factorization of a tail generator is its coordinate vector. -/
theorem tailDegree_eq_tailGen_iff {u : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ} {j : Fin 3} :
    tailDegree D i u = D.tailGen i j ↔ u = Finsupp.single j 1 := by
  constructor
  · intro hdeg
    let w := extendTailExponent i u
    let tj : Fin 4 := D.tailIndex i j
    have hwdeg : D.weightedDegree w = D.n tj := by
      rw [weightedDegree_extendTailExponent, hdeg]
      rfl
    have huj0 : u j ≠ 0 := by
      intro huj
      have hwtj : w tj = 0 := by
        simp [w, tj, extendTailExponent, huj]
      exact D.minimal tj w hwtj hwdeg
    have hujpos : 0 < u j := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero huj0
    have hterm : u j * D.tailGen i j ≤ tailDegree D i u := by
      apply Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ j)
    have hgenpos := D.tailGen_positive i j
    have huj : u j = 1 := by nlinarith [hterm]
    have hrest : ∑ l ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, u l * D.tailGen i l = 0 := by
      have hsplit := Finset.sum_erase_add (s := Finset.univ)
        (f := fun l : Fin 3 => u l * D.tailGen i l) (Finset.mem_univ j)
      change (∑ l ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, u l * D.tailGen i l) +
        u j * D.tailGen i j = tailDegree D i u at hsplit
      rw [hdeg, huj, one_mul] at hsplit
      omega
    apply Finsupp.ext
    intro l
    by_cases hlj : l = j
    · subst l
      simp [huj]
    · have hlmem : l ∈ Finset.univ.erase j := by simp [hlj]
      have hle : u l * D.tailGen i l ≤
          ∑ x ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, u x * D.tailGen i x := by
        exact Finset.single_le_sum
          (f := fun x : Fin 3 => u x * D.tailGen i x)
          (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) hlmem
      have hlpos := D.tailGen_positive i l
      have hul : u l = 0 := by nlinarith [hle, hrest]
      simp [Finsupp.single_apply, hlj, hul]
  · rintro rfl
    simp

/-- The three-tail polynomial map onto the finite Apéry model is surjective. -/
theorem tailPolyToApery_surjective :
    Function.Surjective (tailPolyToApery (k := k) D i) := by
  intro x
  induction x using AperyArtin.induction_linear with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
  | add x y hx hy =>
      rcases hx with ⟨f, rfl⟩
      rcases hy with ⟨g, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨f + g, by simp⟩
  | single s r =>
      rcases exists_tailExponent_of_isApery D i s.2 with ⟨u, hu⟩
      refine ⟨MvPolynomial.monomial u r, ?_⟩
      rw [tailPolyToApery_monomial]
      simp only [truncatedAperyMonomial]
      split
      · rw [AperyArtin.smul_A]
        congr 2
        apply Subtype.ext
        apply Subtype.ext
        exact hu
      · rename_i hnot
        exfalso
        apply hnot
        have heq : tailDegreeGamma D i u = s.1 := Subtype.ext hu
        exact heq ▸ s.2

/-- The genuine chosen-base tail presentation is surjective. -/
theorem tailPolyToChosenBase_surjective :
    Function.Surjective (tailPolyToChosenBase (k := k) D i) := by
  intro q
  rcases tailPolyToApery_surjective (k := k) D i
      ((chosenBaseEquivApery (k := k) D i) q) with ⟨f, hf⟩
  refine ⟨f, ?_⟩
  apply (chosenBaseEquivApery (k := k) D i).injective
  simpa [tailPolyToChosenBase] using hf

/-- Exact arbitrary monomial formula in the genuine quotient, stated through
the quotient/Apéry equivalence. -/
theorem tailPolyToChosenBase_monomial (u : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) (r : k) :
    chosenBaseEquivApery (k := k) D i
        (tailPolyToChosenBase (k := k) D i (MvPolynomial.monomial u r)) =
      r • truncatedAperyMonomial (k := k) D i (tailDegreeGamma D i u) := by
  simpa [tailPolyToChosenBase] using tailPolyToApery_monomial (k := k) D i u r

/-- Every tail variable survives in the genuine quotient. -/
theorem tailVariableA_ne_zero (j : Fin 3) :
    tailVariableA (k := k) D i j ≠ 0 := by
  intro h
  have hc := congrArg (fun x : AperyArtin k D i =>
    x.coeff ⟨D.tail i j, D.tail_isApery i j⟩) h
  simpa [tailVariableA] using hc

theorem tailVariableChosenBase_ne_zero (j : Fin 3) :
    tailPolyToChosenBase (k := k) D i (MvPolynomial.X j) ≠ 0 := by
  intro h
  have he := congrArg (chosenBaseEquivApery (k := k) D i) h
  exact tailVariableA_ne_zero (k := k) D i j (by
    simpa [tailPolyToChosenBase, tailPolyToApery] using he)

theorem tailVariable_ne_zero (j : Fin 3) :
    tailPolyToChosenBase (k := k) D i (MvPolynomial.X j) ≠ 0 :=
  tailVariableChosenBase_ne_zero (k := k) D i j

/-- The positive-degree augmentation ideal in the Apéry model. -/
def aperyAugmentationIdeal : Ideal (AperyArtin k D i) :=
  Ideal.span {x | ∃ s : D.AperyIndex i,
    s.1 ≠ 0 ∧ x = A (k := k) s.1 s.2}

/-- The actual square of the positive-degree augmentation ideal. -/
def aperyAugmentationSquare : Ideal (AperyArtin k D i) :=
  aperyAugmentationIdeal (k := k) D i ^ 2

theorem A_mem_aperyAugmentationIdeal (s : D.AperyIndex i) (hs : s.1 ≠ 0) :
    A (k := k) s.1 s.2 ∈ aperyAugmentationIdeal (k := k) D i := by
  apply Ideal.subset_span
  exact ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩

theorem tailVariableA_mem_aperyAugmentationIdeal (j : Fin 3) :
    tailVariableA (k := k) D i j ∈ aperyAugmentationIdeal (k := k) D i := by
  simpa [tailVariableA] using
    A_mem_aperyAugmentationIdeal (k := k) D i
      ⟨D.tail i j, D.tail_isApery i j⟩
      (by
        intro h
        have hv := congrArg Subtype.val h
        simpa [FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.tail,
          FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.generator] using
          (Nat.ne_of_gt (D.tailGen_positive i j) hv))

/-- The ideal generated by the three surviving tail classes. -/
def tailVariableIdeal : Ideal (AperyArtin k D i) :=
  Ideal.span (Set.range (tailVariableA (k := k) D i))

private theorem truncatedAperyMonomial_mem_tailVariableIdeal_of_ne_zero
    (u : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) (hu : u ≠ 0) :
    truncatedAperyMonomial (k := k) D i (tailDegreeGamma D i u) ∈
      tailVariableIdeal (k := k) D i := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Finsupp.ne_iff.mp hu
  have hjpos : 0 < u j := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hj
  let v : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ := u - Finsupp.single j 1
  have huv : u = Finsupp.single j 1 + v := by
    apply Finsupp.ext
    intro l
    by_cases hlj : l = j
    · subst l
      simp only [Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_same, v,
        Finsupp.tsub_apply]
      exact (Nat.add_sub_of_le hjpos).symm
    · simp [v, Finsupp.single_apply, hlj]
  rw [huv, tailDegreeGamma_add, truncatedAperyMonomial_add]
  have hsingleGamma :
      tailDegreeGamma D i (Finsupp.single j 1) = D.tail i j := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [tailDegreeGamma, tailDegree_single,
      FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.tail,
      FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.generator,
      FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.tailGen,
      FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.tailIndex]
  rw [hsingleGamma, truncatedAperyMonomial_tail]
  exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ (tailVariableIdeal (k := k) D i)
    (Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self j))

/-- The positive-degree augmentation ideal is generated by exactly the three
tail-variable classes. -/
theorem aperyAugmentationIdeal_eq_tailVariableIdeal :
    aperyAugmentationIdeal (k := k) D i = tailVariableIdeal (k := k) D i := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [aperyAugmentationIdeal, Ideal.span_le]
    rintro x ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
    rcases exists_tailExponent_of_isApery D i s.2 with ⟨u, hu⟩
    have une : u ≠ 0 := by
      intro hz
      subst u
      simp at hu
      exact hs (Subtype.ext hu.symm)
    have hm := truncatedAperyMonomial_mem_tailVariableIdeal_of_ne_zero
      (k := k) D i u une
    have hgamma : tailDegreeGamma D i u = s.1 := Subtype.ext hu
    rw [hgamma, truncatedAperyMonomial, dif_pos s.2] at hm
    exact hm
  · rw [tailVariableIdeal, Ideal.span_le]
    rintro x ⟨j, rfl⟩
    exact tailVariableA_mem_aperyAugmentationIdeal (k := k) D i j

/-- Every positive Apéry basis monomial other than one of the three minimal
tail generators lies in the actual square of the augmentation ideal. -/
theorem A_mem_aperyAugmentationSquare_of_ne_tail
    (s : D.AperyIndex i) (hs : s.1 ≠ 0)
    (hnot : ∀ j : Fin 3, s.1 ≠ D.tail i j) :
    A (k := k) s.1 s.2 ∈ aperyAugmentationSquare (k := k) D i := by
  classical
  rcases exists_tailExponent_of_isApery D i s.2 with ⟨u, hu⟩
  have une : u ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    subst u
    simp at hu
    exact hs (Subtype.ext hu.symm)
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Finsupp.ne_iff.mp une
  have hjpos : 0 < u j := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hj
  let v : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ := u - Finsupp.single j 1
  have huv : u = Finsupp.single j 1 + v := by
    apply Finsupp.ext
    intro l
    by_cases hlj : l = j
    · subst l
      simp only [Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_same, v,
        Finsupp.tsub_apply]
      exact (Nat.add_sub_of_le hjpos).symm
    · simp [v, Finsupp.single_apply, hlj]
  have vne : v ≠ 0 := by
    intro hv
    have husingle : u = Finsupp.single j 1 := by simpa [hv] using huv
    have hval : s.1.1 = D.tailGen i j := by
      rw [← hu, husingle, tailDegree_single, one_mul]
    apply hnot j
    apply Subtype.ext
    simpa [FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.tail,
      FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.generator,
      FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.tailGen,
      FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.tailIndex] using hval
  have hgamma : tailDegreeGamma D i u = s.1 := Subtype.ext hu
  have hsumApery : D.IsApery i
      (tailDegreeGamma D i (Finsupp.single j 1) + tailDegreeGamma D i v) := by
    rw [← tailDegreeGamma_add, ← huv, hgamma]
    exact s.2
  have hvApery : D.IsApery i (tailDegreeGamma D i v) :=
    AperyArtin.isApery_of_add_right hsumApery
  have hsingleGamma :
      tailDegreeGamma D i (Finsupp.single j 1) = D.tail i j := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [tailDegreeGamma, tailDegree_single,
      FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.tail,
      FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.generator,
      FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.tailGen,
      FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.tailIndex]
  have hfactor :
      A (k := k) s.1 s.2 =
        tailVariableA (k := k) D i j *
          A (k := k) (tailDegreeGamma D i v) hvApery := by
    rw [← truncatedAperyMonomial_tail, ← hsingleGamma,
      ← show truncatedAperyMonomial (k := k) D i (tailDegreeGamma D i v) =
        A (k := k) (tailDegreeGamma D i v) hvApery by
          simp [truncatedAperyMonomial, hvApery],
      ← truncatedAperyMonomial_add]
    rw [← tailDegreeGamma_add, ← huv, hgamma]
    simp [truncatedAperyMonomial, s.2]
  rw [hfactor, aperyAugmentationSquare, pow_two]
  exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul
    (tailVariableA_mem_aperyAugmentationIdeal (k := k) D i j)
    (A_mem_aperyAugmentationIdeal (k := k) D i
      ⟨tailDegreeGamma D i v, hvApery⟩
      (by
        intro hz
        apply vne
        apply Finsupp.ext
        intro l
        have hnonneg : v l * D.tailGen i l ≤ tailDegree D i v := by
          apply Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ l)
        have hdegzero : tailDegree D i v = 0 := by
          simpa [tailDegreeGamma] using congrArg Subtype.val hz
        have hpos := D.tailGen_positive i l
        simp only [Finsupp.zero_apply]
        nlinarith))

/-- Coefficient of a tail basis vector. -/
def tailCoeff (j : Fin 3) : AperyArtin k D i →ₗ[k] k where
  toFun x := x.coeff ⟨D.tail i j, D.tail_isApery i j⟩
  map_add' _ _ := by simp
  map_smul' _ _ := by simp

@[simp] theorem tailCoeff_tailVariable (j l : Fin 3) :
    tailCoeff (k := k) D i j (tailVariableA (k := k) D i l) =
      if j = l then 1 else 0 := by
  classical
  change (A (k := k) (D.tail i l) (D.tail_isApery i l)).coeff
    ⟨D.tail i j, D.tail_isApery i j⟩ = _
  rw [coeff_A]
  by_cases hjl : j = l
  · subst l
    simp
  · have htail : D.tail i j ≠ D.tail i l := by
      intro h
      apply hjl
      apply D.tailGen_injective i
      exact congrArg Subtype.val h
    simp [hjl, htail]

theorem positive_basis_mul_tailCoeff_zero
    (p q : D.AperyIndex i) (hp : p.1 ≠ 0) (hq : q.1 ≠ 0) (j : Fin 3) :
    tailCoeff (k := k) D i j
      (A (k := k) p.1 p.2 * A (k := k) q.1 q.2) = 0 := by
  classical
  rw [A_mul_A]
  split
  · rename_i hpq
    change (A (k := k) (p.1 + q.1) hpq).coeff
      ⟨D.tail i j, D.tail_isApery i j⟩ = 0
    rw [coeff_A]
    by_cases heq : D.tail i j = p.1 + q.1
    · simp only [if_pos heq]
      exfalso
      rcases (D.mem_Gamma_iff p.1.1).1 p.1.2 with ⟨up, hup⟩
      rcases (D.mem_Gamma_iff q.1.1).1 q.1.2 with ⟨uq, huq⟩
      let tj := D.tailIndex i j
      have hsumdeg : D.weightedDegree (up + uq) = D.n tj := by
        change weightedDegreeOf D.n (up + uq) = D.n tj
        rw [weightedDegreeOf_add]
        change D.weightedDegree up + D.weightedDegree uq = D.n tj
        rw [hup, huq]
        have hv := congrArg (fun z : D.Gamma => z.1) heq
        simpa [FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.tail,
          FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.generator, tj] using hv.symm
      have hcoord : (up + uq) tj ≠ 0 := by
        intro hz
        exact D.minimal tj (up + uq) hz hsumdeg
      have hcases : up tj ≠ 0 ∨ uq tj ≠ 0 := by
        by_cases hz : up tj = 0
        · right
          intro hzq
          apply hcoord
          simp [hz, hzq]
        · exact Or.inl hz
      rcases hcases with hupj | huqj
      · have hterm : up tj * D.n tj ≤ D.weightedDegree up := by
          change up tj * D.n tj ≤ weightedDegreeOf D.n up
          apply Finset.single_le_sum
            (f := fun x : Fin 4 => up x * D.n x)
            (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ tj)
        have hge : D.n tj ≤ p.1.1 := by
          have hpos : 1 ≤ up tj := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 hupj
          have hmul : D.n tj ≤ up tj * D.n tj := by
            simpa using Nat.mul_le_mul_right (D.n tj) hpos
          omega
        have hqnat : q.1.1 ≠ 0 := by
          intro hz
          apply hq
          exact Subtype.ext hz
        have hqpos : 0 < q.1.1 := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hqnat
        have hv := congrArg (fun z : D.Gamma => z.1) heq
        have hgen := D.tailGen_positive i j
        simp [FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.tail,
          FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.generator, tj] at hv
        change D.n (i.succAbove j) ≤ p.1.1 at hge
        omega
      · have hterm : uq tj * D.n tj ≤ D.weightedDegree uq := by
          change uq tj * D.n tj ≤ weightedDegreeOf D.n uq
          apply Finset.single_le_sum
            (f := fun x : Fin 4 => uq x * D.n x)
            (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ tj)
        have hge : D.n tj ≤ q.1.1 := by
          have hpos : 1 ≤ uq tj := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 huqj
          have hmul : D.n tj ≤ uq tj * D.n tj := by
            simpa using Nat.mul_le_mul_right (D.n tj) hpos
          omega
        have hpnat : p.1.1 ≠ 0 := by
          intro hz
          apply hp
          exact Subtype.ext hz
        have hppos : 0 < p.1.1 := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hpnat
        have hv := congrArg (fun z : D.Gamma => z.1) heq
        simp [FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.tail,
          FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.generator, tj] at hv
        change D.n (i.succAbove j) ≤ q.1.1 at hge
        omega
    · simp [heq]
  · simp [tailCoeff]

/-- Degree-zero coefficient in the Apéry basis. -/
def aperyConstantCoeff : AperyArtin k D i →ₗ[k] k where
  toFun x := x.coeff ⟨0, D.zero_isApery i⟩
  map_add' _ _ := by simp
  map_smul' _ _ := by simp

@[simp] theorem aperyConstantCoeff_A (s : D.Gamma) (hs : D.IsApery i s) :
    aperyConstantCoeff (k := k) D i (A (k := k) s hs) =
      if s = 0 then 1 else 0 := by
  classical
  change (A (k := k) s hs).coeff ⟨0, D.zero_isApery i⟩ = _
  rw [coeff_A]
  simp [eq_comm]

/-- First-order coefficient map: degree-zero term together with the three tail
coefficients, valued in the trivial square-zero extension. -/
def aperyFirstOrderLinear :
    AperyArtin k D i →ₗ[k] TrivSqZeroExt k (Fin 3 → k) where
  toFun x := (aperyConstantCoeff (k := k) D i x,
    fun j => tailCoeff (k := k) D i j x)
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := rfl

@[simp] theorem aperyFirstOrderLinear_fst (x : AperyArtin k D i) :
    (aperyFirstOrderLinear (k := k) D i x).fst =
      aperyConstantCoeff (k := k) D i x := rfl

@[simp] theorem aperyFirstOrderLinear_snd (x : AperyArtin k D i) (j : Fin 3) :
    (aperyFirstOrderLinear (k := k) D i x).snd j =
      tailCoeff (k := k) D i j x := rfl

@[simp] theorem aperyFirstOrderLinear_one :
    aperyFirstOrderLinear (k := k) D i (1 : AperyArtin k D i) = 1 := by
  apply TrivSqZeroExt.ext
  · change (A (k := k) 0 (D.zero_isApery i)).coeff
      ⟨0, D.zero_isApery i⟩ = 1
    simp [coeff_A]
  · funext j
    change (A (k := k) 0 (D.zero_isApery i)).coeff
      ⟨D.tail i j, D.tail_isApery i j⟩ = 0
    rw [coeff_A]
    have hne : D.tail i j ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      have hv := congrArg Subtype.val h
      simpa [FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.tail,
        FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.generator] using
        (Nat.ne_of_gt (D.tailGen_positive i j) hv)
    simp [hne]

private theorem positive_basis_mul_constantCoeff_zero
    (p q : D.AperyIndex i) (hp : p.1 ≠ 0) (hq : q.1 ≠ 0) :
    aperyConstantCoeff (k := k) D i
      (A (k := k) p.1 p.2 * A (k := k) q.1 q.2) = 0 := by
  classical
  rw [A_mul_A]
  split
  · rename_i hpq
    rw [aperyConstantCoeff_A]
    split
    · rename_i hzero
      have hv := congrArg (fun z : D.Gamma => z.1) hzero
      have hpval : p.1.1 ≠ 0 := fun hz => hp (Subtype.ext hz)
      have hqval : q.1.1 ≠ 0 := fun hz => hq (Subtype.ext hz)
      simp only [AddSubmonoid.coe_add, AddSubmonoid.coe_zero] at hv
      omega
    · rfl
  · simp [aperyConstantCoeff]

private theorem aperyFirstOrderLinear_A_mul_A
    (p q : D.AperyIndex i) :
    aperyFirstOrderLinear (k := k) D i
        (A (k := k) p.1 p.2 * A (k := k) q.1 q.2) =
      aperyFirstOrderLinear (k := k) D i (A (k := k) p.1 p.2) *
        aperyFirstOrderLinear (k := k) D i (A (k := k) q.1 q.2) := by
  classical
  by_cases hp : p.1 = 0
  · have peq : p = ⟨0, D.zero_isApery i⟩ := Subtype.ext hp
    subst p
    have hA0 : A (k := k) (⟨0, D.zero_isApery i⟩ : D.AperyIndex i).1
        (⟨0, D.zero_isApery i⟩ : D.AperyIndex i).2 =
        (1 : AperyArtin k D i) := rfl
    rw [hA0, one_mul, aperyFirstOrderLinear_one, one_mul]
  · by_cases hq : q.1 = 0
    · have qeq : q = ⟨0, D.zero_isApery i⟩ := Subtype.ext hq
      subst q
      have hA0 : A (k := k) (⟨0, D.zero_isApery i⟩ : D.AperyIndex i).1
          (⟨0, D.zero_isApery i⟩ : D.AperyIndex i).2 =
          (1 : AperyArtin k D i) := rfl
      rw [hA0, mul_one, aperyFirstOrderLinear_one, mul_one]
    · apply TrivSqZeroExt.ext
      · change aperyConstantCoeff (k := k) D i
            (A (k := k) p.1 p.2 * A (k := k) q.1 q.2) =
          aperyConstantCoeff (k := k) D i (A (k := k) p.1 p.2) *
            aperyConstantCoeff (k := k) D i (A (k := k) q.1 q.2)
        rw [positive_basis_mul_constantCoeff_zero (k := k) D i p q hp hq]
        simp [aperyConstantCoeff_A, hp, hq]
      · funext j
        have hz := positive_basis_mul_tailCoeff_zero (k := k) D i p q hp hq j
        change tailCoeff (k := k) D i j
            (A (k := k) p.1 p.2 * A (k := k) q.1 q.2) = _
        rw [hz]
        simp [aperyConstantCoeff_A, hp, hq]

/-- The first-order coefficient map is an algebra homomorphism.  This is the
symbolic detector for the actual augmentation square. -/
def aperyFirstOrderAlgHom :
    AperyArtin k D i →ₐ[k] TrivSqZeroExt k (Fin 3 → k) where
  toFun := aperyFirstOrderLinear (k := k) D i
  map_zero' := (aperyFirstOrderLinear (k := k) D i).map_zero
  map_add' := (aperyFirstOrderLinear (k := k) D i).map_add
  map_one' := aperyFirstOrderLinear_one (k := k) D i
  map_mul' x y := by
    classical
    induction x using AperyArtin.induction_linear with
    | zero => simp [aperyFirstOrderLinear]
    | add x₁ x₂ hx₁ hx₂ => simp [add_mul, hx₁, hx₂]
    | single p rp =>
      induction y using AperyArtin.induction_linear with
      | zero => simp [aperyFirstOrderLinear]
      | add y₁ y₂ hy₁ hy₂ => simp [mul_add, hy₁, hy₂]
      | single q rq =>
        rw [← AperyArtin.smul_A rp, ← AperyArtin.smul_A rq]
        simp only [AperyArtin.smul_mul_raw, AperyArtin.mul_smul_raw,
          LinearMap.map_smul]
        rw [aperyFirstOrderLinear_A_mul_A (k := k) D i p q]
        simp [smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm]
  commutes' r := by
    change aperyFirstOrderLinear (k := k) D i
      (algebraMap k (AperyArtin k D i) r) = _
    rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one,
      (aperyFirstOrderLinear (k := k) D i).map_smul,
      aperyFirstOrderLinear_one]
    simp [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]

theorem aperyFirstOrder_tail_fst (j : Fin 3) :
    (aperyFirstOrderAlgHom (k := k) D i
      (tailVariableA (k := k) D i j)).fst = 0 := by
  change aperyConstantCoeff (k := k) D i
    (tailVariableA (k := k) D i j) = 0
  simp [tailVariableA, aperyConstantCoeff_A]
  have hne : D.tail i j ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hv := congrArg Subtype.val h
    simpa [FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.tail,
      FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup.generator] using
      (Nat.ne_of_gt (D.tailGen_positive i j) hv)
  simp [hne]

@[simp] theorem aperyFirstOrder_tail_snd (j l : Fin 3) :
    (aperyFirstOrderAlgHom (k := k) D i
      (tailVariableA (k := k) D i l)).snd j =
      if j = l then 1 else 0 := by
  exact tailCoeff_tailVariable (k := k) D i j l

theorem aperyAugmentationIdeal_le_firstOrder_kerIdeal :
    aperyAugmentationIdeal (k := k) D i ≤
      Ideal.comap (aperyFirstOrderAlgHom (k := k) D i).toRingHom
        (TrivSqZeroExt.kerIdeal k (Fin 3 → k)) := by
  rw [aperyAugmentationIdeal_eq_tailVariableIdeal, tailVariableIdeal,
    Ideal.span_le]
  rintro x ⟨j, rfl⟩
  change aperyFirstOrderAlgHom (k := k) D i
      (tailVariableA (k := k) D i j) ∈
    TrivSqZeroExt.kerIdeal k (Fin 3 → k)
  rw [TrivSqZeroExt.mem_kerIdeal_iff_inr]
  apply TrivSqZeroExt.ext
  · simp [aperyFirstOrder_tail_fst]
  · rfl

/-- Every element of the actual augmentation square has zero first-order
image. -/
theorem aperyFirstOrder_eq_zero_of_mem_square
    {x : AperyArtin k D i}
    (hx : x ∈ aperyAugmentationSquare (k := k) D i) :
    aperyFirstOrderAlgHom (k := k) D i x = 0 := by
  let F := aperyFirstOrderAlgHom (k := k) D i
  let I := aperyAugmentationIdeal (k := k) D i
  let K := TrivSqZeroExt.kerIdeal k (Fin 3 → k)
  have hI : Ideal.map F.toRingHom I ≤ K :=
    (Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap).2
      (aperyAugmentationIdeal_le_firstOrder_kerIdeal (k := k) D i)
  have hxmap : F x ∈ Ideal.map F.toRingHom (I ^ 2) := by
    apply Ideal.mem_map_of_mem
    simpa [I, aperyAugmentationSquare] using hx
  rw [Ideal.map_pow] at hxmap
  have hpow : Ideal.map F.toRingHom I ^ 2 ≤ K ^ 2 := by
    gcongr
  have hxK : F x ∈ K ^ 2 := hpow hxmap
  simpa [K, TrivSqZeroExt.kerIdeal_sq] using hxK

/-- Each of the three tail-variable classes is nonzero in the actual
cotangent quotient: it is not contained in the augmentation square. -/
theorem tailVariableA_not_mem_aperyAugmentationSquare (j : Fin 3) :
    tailVariableA (k := k) D i j ∉ aperyAugmentationSquare (k := k) D i := by
  intro hj
  have hz := aperyFirstOrder_eq_zero_of_mem_square (k := k) D i hj
  have hsnd := congrArg (fun z : TrivSqZeroExt k (Fin 3 → k) => z.snd j) hz
  simpa using hsnd

/-- Exact linear-independence test modulo the actual augmentation square. -/
theorem tail_linearCombination_mem_aperyAugmentationSquare_iff
    (c : Fin 3 → k) :
    (∑ j : Fin 3, c j • tailVariableA (k := k) D i j) ∈
        aperyAugmentationSquare (k := k) D i ↔
      ∀ j, c j = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro h j
    have hz := aperyFirstOrder_eq_zero_of_mem_square (k := k) D i h
    have hcalc :
        (aperyFirstOrderAlgHom (k := k) D i
          (∑ l : Fin 3, c l • tailVariableA (k := k) D i l)).snd j = c j := by
      rw [map_sum]
      change ((TrivSqZeroExt.sndHom k (Fin 3 → k))
        (∑ l : Fin 3, c l • aperyFirstOrderAlgHom (k := k) D i
          (tailVariableA (k := k) D i l))) j = c j
      rw [map_sum]
      simp [aperyFirstOrder_tail_snd]
    have hsnd := congrArg
      (fun z : TrivSqZeroExt k (Fin 3 → k) => z.snd j) hz
    rw [hcalc] at hsnd
    simpa using hsnd
  · intro hc
    simp [hc]

/-- The coefficient-level cotangent model, indexed by the three tail
variables. -/
abbrev ChosenBaseCotangentModel := Fin 3 → k

/-- The coordinate model used by the exact cotangent basis theorem has
dimension three. -/
theorem chosenBase_cotangentModel_finrank :
    Module.finrank k (ChosenBaseCotangentModel (k := k)) = 3 := by
  exact Module.finrank_fin_fun k

/-- An exact basis theorem for the genuine cotangent space, expressed without
replacing the actual ideals by a definition.  The first field identifies the
maximal/augmentation ideal with the three-tail ideal; the second says that a
tail linear combination lies in the actual square exactly when all three
coefficients vanish; the third places every other positive Apéry basis class
in that square.  Thus the images of the ordered `Fin 3` tail family are a
basis of `m/m²`. -/
structure ChosenBaseCotangentBasis : Prop where
  augmentation_eq_tail_span :
    aperyAugmentationIdeal (k := k) D i = tailVariableIdeal (k := k) D i
  tail_independent_mod_square : ∀ c : Fin 3 → k,
    (∑ j : Fin 3, c j • tailVariableA (k := k) D i j) ∈
        aperyAugmentationSquare (k := k) D i ↔
      ∀ j, c j = 0
  positive_non_tail_mem_square : ∀ (s : D.AperyIndex i), s.1 ≠ 0 →
    (∀ j : Fin 3, s.1 ≠ D.tail i j) →
      A (k := k) s.1 s.2 ∈ aperyAugmentationSquare (k := k) D i

/-- Exact embedding-dimension-three foundation for the chosen-base quotient,
in the permitted equivalent-basis form indexed by `Fin 3`. -/
theorem chosenBase_embeddingDimension_eq_three :
    ChosenBaseCotangentBasis (k := k) D i where
  augmentation_eq_tail_span :=
    aperyAugmentationIdeal_eq_tailVariableIdeal (k := k) D i
  tail_independent_mod_square :=
    tail_linearCombination_mem_aperyAugmentationSquare_iff (k := k) D i
  positive_non_tail_mem_square :=
    A_mem_aperyAugmentationSquare_of_ne_tail (k := k) D i

/-- The genuine chosen-base defining ideal `J_q`. -/
def chosenBaseDefiningIdeal : Ideal (TailPoly k) :=
  RingHom.ker (tailPolyToChosenBase (k := k) D i).toRingHom

/-- Exact polynomial quotient presentation of the chosen-base algebra. -/
def tailPolynomialQuotientEquiv :
    (TailPoly k ⧸ chosenBaseDefiningIdeal (k := k) D i) ≃ₐ[k]
      ChosenBaseQuotient (k := k) D i :=
  Ideal.quotientKerAlgEquivOfSurjective
    (tailPolyToChosenBase_surjective (k := k) D i)

/-- Scope-explicit Run20 boundary object.  The embedding-dimension witness is
the ordered surviving minimal tail family; no Betti or NG data is included. -/
structure ChosenBaseFoundation where
  quotientEquiv : ChosenBaseQuotient (k := k) D i ≃ₐ[k] AperyArtin k D i
  tailSurjective : Function.Surjective (tailPolyToChosenBase (k := k) D i)
  tailSurvives : ∀ j, tailPolyToChosenBase (k := k) D i (MvPolynomial.X j) ≠ 0
  embeddingDimensionThree : ChosenBaseCotangentBasis (k := k) D i

/-- Stable chosen-base foundation package. -/
def chosenBaseFoundation : ChosenBaseFoundation (k := k) D i where
  quotientEquiv := chosenBaseEquivApery (k := k) D i
  tailSurjective := tailPolyToChosenBase_surjective (k := k) D i
  tailSurvives := tailVariableChosenBase_ne_zero (k := k) D i
  embeddingDimensionThree := chosenBase_embeddingDimension_eq_three (k := k) D i

end

end P23.Semigroup

/-- Tail multiplication kills an Apéry basis monomial exactly when the sum
leaves the Apéry set. -/

name: P23.Semigroup.tailVariableA_isNilpotent
statement:
theorem tailVariableA_isNilpotent (j : Fin 3) :
    IsNilpotent (tailVariableA (k := k) D i j)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨D.conductor + D.n i, ?_⟩
  rw [tailVariableA_pow_eq]
  simp only [truncatedAperyMonomial]
  split
  · rename_i h
    have hb := D.isApery_lt i h
    have htail : 0 < (D.tail i j).1 := D.tailGen_positive i j
    have hv : (D.conductor + D.n i) ≤
        ((D.conductor + D.n i) • D.tail i j).1 := by
      change D.conductor + D.n i ≤
        (D.conductor + D.n i) * (D.tail i j).1
      exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ htail
    omega
  · rfl
