-- [Emissary prelude] P23.Semigroup.FourGenerated — verbatim (imports stripped)
namespace P23.Semigroup

open scoped BigOperators

noncomputable section

/-- Weighted degree for an ordered family of four natural generators. -/
def weightedDegreeOf (n : Fin 4 → ℕ) (u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ∑ j : Fin 4, u j * n j

@[simp] theorem weightedDegreeOf_zero (n : Fin 4 → ℕ) :
    weightedDegreeOf n 0 = 0 := by simp [weightedDegreeOf]

theorem weightedDegreeOf_add (n : Fin 4 → ℕ) (u v : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) :
    weightedDegreeOf n (u + v) = weightedDegreeOf n u + weightedDegreeOf n v := by
  simp [weightedDegreeOf, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

/-- The additive weighted-degree homomorphism. -/
def weightedDegreeHomOf (n : Fin 4 → ℕ) : (Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) →+ ℕ where
  toFun := weightedDegreeOf n
  map_zero' := weightedDegreeOf_zero n
  map_add' := weightedDegreeOf_add n

/-- The additive submonoid generated by the ordered family. -/
def generatedByFour (n : Fin 4 → ℕ) : AddSubmonoid ℕ :=
  AddMonoidHom.mrange (weightedDegreeHomOf n)

/-- Ordered, positive, minimal four-generator data whose generated submonoid
has finite complement in `ℕ`. -/
structure FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup where
  n : Fin 4 → ℕ
  positive : ∀ j, 0 < n j
  injective : Function.Injective n
  minimal : ∀ j (u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ), u j = 0 → weightedDegreeOf n u ≠ n j
  cofinite : Set.Finite {s : ℕ | s ∉ generatedByFour n}

namespace FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup

variable (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup)

/-- Weighted degree attached to the chosen four generators. -/
abbrev weightedDegree (u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) : ℕ := weightedDegreeOf D.n u

/-- The numerical semigroup generated by the four ordered generators. -/
abbrev Gamma : AddSubmonoid ℕ := generatedByFour D.n

/-- Exact generation/factorization interface. -/
theorem mem_Gamma_iff (s : ℕ) :
    s ∈ D.Gamma ↔ ∃ u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ, D.weightedDegree u = s := by
  exact AddMonoidHom.mem_mrange

/-- The coordinate vector selecting one generator. -/
def generatorFactorization (j : Fin 4) : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ := Finsupp.single j 1

@[simp] theorem weightedDegree_generatorFactorization (j : Fin 4) :
    D.weightedDegree (generatorFactorization j) = D.n j := by
  classical
  simp only [weightedDegreeOf, generatorFactorization]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
  · simp
  · intro b _ hbj
    simp [Finsupp.single_apply, hbj]
  · simp

theorem generator_mem_Gamma (j : Fin 4) : D.n j ∈ D.Gamma :=
  (D.mem_Gamma_iff (D.n j)).2 ⟨generatorFactorization j,
    D.weightedDegree_generatorFactorization j⟩

/-- A semigroup element represented as an element of the generated subtype. -/
def generator (j : Fin 4) : D.Gamma := ⟨D.n j, D.generator_mem_Gamma j⟩

/-- A fixed-degree factorization. -/
abbrev Factorization (s : ℕ) := {u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ // D.weightedDegree u = s}

theorem coordinate_le_weightedDegree (u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) (j : Fin 4) :
    u j ≤ D.weightedDegree u := by
  have hterm : u j * D.n j ≤ D.weightedDegree u := by
    apply Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ j)
  have hone : 1 ≤ D.n j := D.positive j
  simpa only [Nat.mul_one] using (Nat.mul_le_mul_left (u j) hone).trans hterm

theorem factorization_coordinate_le {s : ℕ} (u : D.Factorization s) (j : Fin 4) :
    u.1 j ≤ s := by
  simpa [u.2] using D.coordinate_le_weightedDegree u.1 j

instance factorizationFinite (s : ℕ) : Finite (D.Factorization s) := by
  let f : D.Factorization s → (Fin 4 → Fin (s + 1)) := fun u j =>
    ⟨u.1 j, Nat.lt_succ_of_le (D.factorization_coordinate_le u j)⟩
  exact Finite.of_injective f (by
    intro u v h
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Finsupp.ext
    intro j
    exact congrArg (fun g => (g j : ℕ)) h)

/-- The finite set of all exponent vectors of a fixed semigroup degree. -/
def factorizations (s : ℕ) : Finset (Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) :=
  letI := Fintype.ofFinite (D.Factorization s)
  Finset.univ.image (fun u : D.Factorization s => u.1)

@[simp] theorem mem_factorizations {s : ℕ} {u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ} :
    u ∈ D.factorizations s ↔ D.weightedDegree u = s := by
  classical
  simp [factorizations]

/-- The selected base generator. -/
def base (i : Fin 4) : D.Gamma := D.generator i

/-- The exact embedding of the three tail indices into the four indices. -/
def tailIndex (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup) (i : Fin 4) : Fin 3 ↪ Fin 4 :=
  i.succAboveEmb

@[simp] theorem tailIndex_apply (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) :
    D.tailIndex i j = i.succAbove j := rfl

theorem tailIndex_ne_base (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) : D.tailIndex i j ≠ i := by
  simpa [tailIndex] using Fin.succAbove_ne i j

theorem tailIndex_injective (i : Fin 4) : Function.Injective (D.tailIndex i) :=
  (D.tailIndex i).injective

/-- The three generators other than the selected base. -/
def tailGen (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) : ℕ := D.n (D.tailIndex i j)

theorem tailGen_positive (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) : 0 < D.tailGen i j :=
  D.positive _

theorem tailGen_injective (i : Fin 4) : Function.Injective (D.tailGen i) :=
  D.injective.comp (D.tailIndex_injective i)

theorem tailGen_ne_base (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) : D.tailGen i j ≠ D.n i := by
  exact fun h => D.tailIndex_ne_base i j (D.injective h)

/-- Tail generator as a semigroup element. -/
def tail (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) : D.Gamma := D.generator (D.tailIndex i j)

/-- Apéry membership is absence of an additive predecessor by the selected
base.  This definition deliberately avoids truncated subtraction. -/
def IsApery (i : Fin 4) (s : D.Gamma) : Prop :=
  ¬ ∃ h : D.Gamma, s = D.base i + h

theorem zero_isApery (i : Fin 4) : D.IsApery i 0 := by
  rintro ⟨h, hh⟩
  have := congrArg Subtype.val hh
  have hq := D.positive i
  simp only [AddSubmonoid.coe_zero, AddSubmonoid.coe_add, base, generator] at this
  omega

theorem base_not_isApery (i : Fin 4) : ¬ D.IsApery i (D.base i) := by
  refine fun h => h ⟨0, ?_⟩
  simp

private theorem weighted_term_le (u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) (j : Fin 4) :
    u j * D.n j ≤ D.weightedDegree u := by
  apply Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ j)

theorem tail_isApery (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) : D.IsApery i (D.tail i j) := by
  rintro ⟨h, hh⟩
  rcases (D.mem_Gamma_iff h.1).1 h.2 with ⟨u, hu⟩
  let tj : Fin 4 := D.tailIndex i j
  have heq : D.n tj = D.n i + D.weightedDegree u := by
    have hraw := congrArg Subtype.val hh
    have hraw' : D.n tj = D.n i + h.1 := by
      simpa [tj, tail, generator, base] using hraw
    rw [hraw', hu]
  have hut : u tj = 0 := by
    by_contra hne
    have hone : 1 ≤ u tj := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 hne
    have hterm := D.weighted_term_le u tj
    have hmul : D.n tj ≤ u tj * D.n tj := by
      simpa [one_mul] using Nat.mul_le_mul_right (D.n tj) hone
    have hni := D.positive i
    omega
  let v : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ := Finsupp.single i 1 + u
  have hvzero : v tj = 0 := by
    have hit : i ≠ tj := (D.tailIndex_ne_base i j).symm
    simp [v, Finsupp.single_apply, hit, hut]
  have hsingle : weightedDegreeOf D.n (Finsupp.single i 1) = D.n i := by
    simpa [generatorFactorization] using D.weightedDegree_generatorFactorization i
  have hvdeg : D.weightedDegree v = D.n tj := by
    change weightedDegreeOf D.n v = D.n tj
    rw [show v = Finsupp.single i 1 + u by rfl, weightedDegreeOf_add, hsingle]
    exact heq.symm
  exact (D.minimal tj v hvzero) hvdeg

/-- The finite set of gaps of the generated semigroup. -/
def gapFinset : Finset ℕ := D.cofinite.toFinset

@[simp] theorem mem_gapFinset (s : ℕ) : s ∈ D.gapFinset ↔ s ∉ D.Gamma := by
  simp [gapFinset]

/-- A concrete conductor bound extracted from cofiniteness. -/
def conductor : ℕ := D.gapFinset.sup id + 1

theorem mem_Gamma_of_conductor_le {s : ℕ} (hs : D.conductor ≤ s) : s ∈ D.Gamma := by
  by_contra hnot
  have hmem : s ∈ D.gapFinset := (D.mem_gapFinset s).2 hnot
  have hle : s ≤ D.gapFinset.sup id := Finset.le_sup (f := id) hmem
  simp [conductor] at hs
  omega

theorem isApery_lt (i : Fin 4) {s : D.Gamma} (hs : D.IsApery i s) :
    s.1 < D.conductor + D.n i := by
  by_contra hnot
  have hqi : D.n i ≤ s.1 := by
    have hc : D.conductor ≤ s.1 := by omega
    have hq := D.positive i
    omega
  let d : ℕ := s.1 - D.n i
  have hdcond : D.conductor ≤ d := by omega
  have hdmem : d ∈ D.Gamma := D.mem_Gamma_of_conductor_le hdcond
  apply hs
  refine ⟨⟨d, hdmem⟩, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp [base, generator, d, Nat.add_sub_of_le hqi]

/-- The finite subtype indexing the Apéry basis. -/
abbrev AperyIndex (i : Fin 4) := {s : D.Gamma // D.IsApery i s}

instance aperyIndexFinite (i : Fin 4) : Finite (D.AperyIndex i) := by
  let f : D.AperyIndex i → Fin (D.conductor + D.n i) := fun s =>
    ⟨s.1.1, D.isApery_lt i s.2⟩
  exact Finite.of_injective f (by
    intro s t h
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact congrArg Fin.val h)

/-- Exact finite Apéry set inside the semigroup subtype. -/
def aperyFinset (i : Fin 4) : Finset D.Gamma :=
  letI := Fintype.ofFinite (D.AperyIndex i)
  Finset.univ.map
    (⟨fun s : D.AperyIndex i => s.1, Subtype.val_injective⟩ :
      D.AperyIndex i ↪ D.Gamma)

@[simp] theorem mem_aperyFinset (i : Fin 4) (s : D.Gamma) :
    s ∈ D.aperyFinset i ↔ D.IsApery i s := by
  classical
  simp [aperyFinset]

theorem zero_mem_aperyFinset (i : Fin 4) : 0 ∈ D.aperyFinset i := by
  simpa using D.zero_isApery i

theorem base_not_mem_aperyFinset (i : Fin 4) : D.base i ∉ D.aperyFinset i := by
  simpa using D.base_not_isApery i

theorem tail_mem_aperyFinset (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) :
    D.tail i j ∈ D.aperyFinset i := by
  simpa using D.tail_isApery i j

/-- Any factorization of an Apéry degree has zero coordinate at the chosen
base.  This is the symbolic bridge used by the tail presentation; no
factorization uniqueness is asserted. -/
theorem apery_factorization_base_eq_zero (i : Fin 4) {s : D.Gamma}
    (hs : D.IsApery i s) (u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) (hu : D.weightedDegree u = s.1) :
    u i = 0 := by
  by_contra hnonzero
  have hui : 0 < u i := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hnonzero
  let v : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ := Finsupp.single i (u i - 1) + u.erase i
  have huv : u = Finsupp.single i 1 + v := by
    apply Finsupp.ext
    intro j
    by_cases hji : j = i
    · subst j
      simp [v]
      omega
    · simp [v, Finsupp.single_apply, hji]
  have hvGamma : D.weightedDegree v ∈ D.Gamma :=
    (D.mem_Gamma_iff _).2 ⟨v, rfl⟩
  apply hs
  refine ⟨⟨D.weightedDegree v, hvGamma⟩, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hsingle : D.weightedDegree (Finsupp.single i 1) = D.n i := by
    simpa [generatorFactorization] using D.weightedDegree_generatorFactorization i
  rw [← hu, huv]
  change weightedDegreeOf D.n (Finsupp.single i 1 + v) =
    D.n i + weightedDegreeOf D.n v
  change weightedDegreeOf D.n (Finsupp.single i 1) = D.n i at hsingle
  rw [weightedDegreeOf_add, hsingle]

end FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup

end

end P23.Semigroup

-- [Emissary prelude] P23.Semigroup.BettiFibers — verbatim (imports stripped)
namespace P23.Semigroup

open scoped BigOperators

noncomputable section

namespace FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup

variable (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup)

/-- The stable vertex type of the factorization fiber of degree `d`. -/
abbrev FactorizationAt (d : ℕ) := {u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ // u ∈ D.factorizations d}

instance factorizationAtFintype (d : ℕ) : Fintype (D.FactorizationAt d) :=
  Fintype.ofFinset (D.factorizations d) (fun _ => Iff.rfl)

@[simp] theorem factorizationAt_degree {d : ℕ} (u : D.FactorizationAt d) :
    D.weightedDegree u.1 = d :=
  D.mem_factorizations.mp u.2

/-- Variables occurring with positive exponent in a factorization. -/
def factorizationSupport {d : ℕ} (u : D.FactorizationAt d) : Finset (Fin 4) :=
  u.1.support

@[simp] theorem mem_factorizationSupport {d : ℕ} (u : D.FactorizationAt d)
    (j : Fin 4) :
    j ∈ D.factorizationSupport u ↔ 0 < u.1 j := by
  simp [factorizationSupport, Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero]

/-- Two factorizations overlap when they use a common generator. -/
def FactorizationOverlap {d : ℕ} (u v : D.FactorizationAt d) : Prop :=
  ∃ j : Fin 4, 0 < u.1 j ∧ 0 < v.1 j

theorem factorizationOverlap_comm {d : ℕ} (u v : D.FactorizationAt d) :
    D.FactorizationOverlap u v ↔ D.FactorizationOverlap v u := by
  constructor <;> rintro ⟨j, hu, hv⟩ <;> exact ⟨j, hv, hu⟩

/-- The overlap graph on a fixed factorization fiber. -/
def factorizationGraph (d : ℕ) : SimpleGraph (D.FactorizationAt d) :=
  SimpleGraph.fromRel D.FactorizationOverlap

noncomputable instance factorizationGraphAdjDecidable (d : ℕ) :
    DecidableRel (D.factorizationGraph d).Adj := by
  classical
  exact Classical.decRel _

@[simp] theorem factorizationGraph_adj {d : ℕ} (u v : D.FactorizationAt d) :
    (D.factorizationGraph d).Adj u v ↔
      u ≠ v ∧ D.FactorizationOverlap u v := by
  simp only [factorizationGraph, SimpleGraph.fromRel_adj]
  rw [D.factorizationOverlap_comm v u, or_self]

abbrev BettiComponent (d : ℕ) := (D.factorizationGraph d).ConnectedComponent

noncomputable instance bettiComponentFintype (d : ℕ) :
    Fintype (D.BettiComponent d) := by
  classical
  infer_instance

abbrev componentOf {d : ℕ} (u : D.FactorizationAt d) : D.BettiComponent d :=
  (D.factorizationGraph d).connectedComponentMk u

/-- Number `c_d` of overlap-connected components. -/
def componentCount (d : ℕ) : ℕ := Fintype.card (D.BettiComponent d)

/-- A Betti degree is a fiber with at least two overlap components. -/
def IsBettiDegree (d : ℕ) : Prop := 2 ≤ D.componentCount d

theorem componentOf_eq_iff_reachable {d : ℕ} (u v : D.FactorizationAt d) :
    D.componentOf u = D.componentOf v ↔ (D.factorizationGraph d).Reachable u v :=
  SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.eq

/-- Support of one connected component. -/
def componentSupport {d : ℕ} (C : D.BettiComponent d) : Finset (Fin 4) :=
  by
    classical
    exact (Finset.univ.filter fun u : D.FactorizationAt d => D.componentOf u = C).biUnion
      (fun u => D.factorizationSupport u)

/-- Combined support `V_d` of the whole factorization fiber. -/
def combinedSupport (d : ℕ) : Finset (Fin 4) :=
  by
    classical
    exact Finset.univ.biUnion (fun u : D.FactorizationAt d => D.factorizationSupport u)

/-- Cardinality `v_d` of the combined fiber support. -/
def supportCard (d : ℕ) : ℕ := (D.combinedSupport d).card

theorem mem_componentSupport_iff {d : ℕ} {C : D.BettiComponent d} {j : Fin 4} :
    j ∈ D.componentSupport C ↔
      ∃ u : D.FactorizationAt d, D.componentOf u = C ∧ 0 < u.1 j := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hj
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hj⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hj
    exact ⟨u, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hu).2, (D.mem_factorizationSupport u j).mp hj⟩
  · rintro ⟨u, huC, huj⟩
    exact Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨u, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, huC⟩,
      (D.mem_factorizationSupport u j).mpr huj⟩

theorem mem_combinedSupport_iff {d : ℕ} {j : Fin 4} :
    j ∈ D.combinedSupport d ↔ ∃ u : D.FactorizationAt d, 0 < u.1 j := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hj
    obtain ⟨u, _, hj⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hj
    exact ⟨u, (D.mem_factorizationSupport u j).mp hj⟩
  · rintro ⟨u, huj⟩
    exact Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr
      ⟨u, Finset.mem_univ _, (D.mem_factorizationSupport u j).mpr huj⟩

theorem componentSupport_subset_combinedSupport {d : ℕ} (C : D.BettiComponent d) :
    D.componentSupport C ⊆ D.combinedSupport d := by
  intro j hj
  rw [D.mem_componentSupport_iff] at hj
  rw [D.mem_combinedSupport_iff]
  exact ⟨hj.choose, hj.choose_spec.2⟩

theorem biUnion_componentSupport (d : ℕ) :
    Finset.univ.biUnion (fun C : D.BettiComponent d => D.componentSupport C) =
      D.combinedSupport d := by
  classical
  ext j
  simp only [Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨C, hj⟩
    exact D.componentSupport_subset_combinedSupport C hj
  · intro hj
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := D.mem_combinedSupport_iff.mp hj
    exact ⟨D.componentOf u, D.mem_componentSupport_iff.mpr ⟨u, rfl, hu⟩⟩

/-- Distinct overlap components use disjoint generator sets. -/
theorem componentSupport_disjoint {d : ℕ} {C E : D.BettiComponent d}
    (hCE : C ≠ E) : Disjoint (D.componentSupport C) (D.componentSupport E) := by
  classical
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro j hjC hjE
  obtain ⟨u, huC, huj⟩ := D.mem_componentSupport_iff.mp hjC
  obtain ⟨v, hvE, hvj⟩ := D.mem_componentSupport_iff.mp hjE
  apply hCE
  rw [← huC, ← hvE]
  by_cases huv : u = v
  · exact congrArg D.componentOf huv
  · exact SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.sound
      ((D.factorizationGraph_adj u v).2 ⟨huv, ⟨j, huj, hvj⟩⟩).reachable

theorem componentSupport_pairwiseDisjoint (d : ℕ) :
    (Set.univ : Set (D.BettiComponent d)).PairwiseDisjoint D.componentSupport := by
  intro C _ E _ hCE
  exact D.componentSupport_disjoint hCE

theorem factorization_eq_zero_of_degree_eq_zero {d : ℕ} (hd : d = 0)
    (u : D.FactorizationAt d) : u.1 = 0 := by
  apply Finsupp.ext
  intro j
  have hle := D.factorization_coordinate_le
    (⟨u.1, D.factorizationAt_degree u⟩ : D.Factorization d) j
  simp [hd] at hle
  exact hle

@[simp] theorem weightedDegree_single (j : Fin 4) (m : ℕ) :
    D.weightedDegree (Finsupp.single j m) = m * D.n j := by
  classical
  simp only [weightedDegreeOf]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
  · simp
  · intro k _ hkj
    simp [Finsupp.single_apply, hkj]
  · simp

theorem componentSupport_nonempty_of_isBetti {d : ℕ} (hd : D.IsBettiDegree d)
    (C : D.BettiComponent d) : (D.componentSupport C).Nonempty := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨u, huC⟩ := SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.nonempty_supp C
  by_contra hempty
  have husupp : D.factorizationSupport u = ∅ := by
    apply Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp
    intro hsupp
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hsupp
    apply hempty
    exact ⟨j, D.mem_componentSupport_iff.mpr
      ⟨u, (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff C u).mp huC,
        (D.mem_factorizationSupport u j).mp hj⟩⟩
  have hu0 : u.1 = 0 := Finsupp.support_eq_empty.mp husupp
  have hd0 : d = 0 := by simpa [hu0] using (D.factorizationAt_degree u).symm
  letI : Subsingleton (D.FactorizationAt d) :=
    ⟨fun x y => Subtype.ext (by
      rw [D.factorization_eq_zero_of_degree_eq_zero hd0 x,
        D.factorization_eq_zero_of_degree_eq_zero hd0 y])⟩
  have hcard : D.componentCount d ≤ 1 :=
    Fintype.card_le_one_iff_subsingleton.mpr inferInstance
  unfold IsBettiDegree at hd
  omega

/-- A component supported on exactly one generator. -/
def IsSingletonSupportComponent {d : ℕ} (C : D.BettiComponent d) : Prop :=
  (D.componentSupport C).card = 1

/-- Number `ell_d` of singleton-support components. -/
def singletonComponentCount (d : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  by
    classical
    exact (Finset.univ.filter fun C : D.BettiComponent d =>
      D.IsSingletonSupportComponent C).card

/-- The unique support variable of a singleton component (arbitrary only when
the support is empty, a branch never used by singleton theorems). -/
def singletonSupportVariable {d : ℕ} (C : D.BettiComponent d) : Fin 4 :=
  if h : (D.componentSupport C).Nonempty then h.choose else 0

theorem singletonSupportVariable_mem {d : ℕ} {C : D.BettiComponent d}
    (hC : D.IsSingletonSupportComponent C) :
    D.singletonSupportVariable C ∈ D.componentSupport C := by
  have hn : (D.componentSupport C).Nonempty := Finset.card_pos.mp (by
    unfold IsSingletonSupportComponent at hC
    omega)
  simp [singletonSupportVariable, hn, hn.choose_spec]

theorem componentSupport_eq_singleton {d : ℕ} {C : D.BettiComponent d}
    (hC : D.IsSingletonSupportComponent C) :
    D.componentSupport C = {D.singletonSupportVariable C} := by
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.mp hC
  have hvar := D.singletonSupportVariable_mem hC
  rw [hj] at hvar
  have heq : D.singletonSupportVariable C = j := by simpa using hvar
  simpa [heq] using hj

theorem factorizationSupport_subset_componentSupport {d : ℕ}
    {C : D.BettiComponent d} {u : D.FactorizationAt d}
    (hu : D.componentOf u = C) :
    D.factorizationSupport u ⊆ D.componentSupport C := by
  intro j hj
  exact D.mem_componentSupport_iff.mpr
    ⟨u, hu, (D.mem_factorizationSupport u j).mp hj⟩

theorem factorization_eq_single_of_singleton_component {d : ℕ}
    {C : D.BettiComponent d} (hC : D.IsSingletonSupportComponent C)
    {u : D.FactorizationAt d} (hu : D.componentOf u = C) :
    u.1 = Finsupp.single (D.singletonSupportVariable C)
      (u.1 (D.singletonSupportVariable C)) := by
  classical
  apply Finsupp.ext
  intro j
  by_cases hj : j = D.singletonSupportVariable C
  · subst j
    simp
  · have hjnot : j ∉ D.factorizationSupport u := by
      intro hmem
      have := D.factorizationSupport_subset_componentSupport hu hmem
      rw [D.componentSupport_eq_singleton hC] at this
      simpa [hj] using this
    have hz : u.1 j = 0 := by
      simpa [factorizationSupport] using hjnot
    simp [Finsupp.single_apply, hj, hz]

theorem singleton_component_vertex_unique {d : ℕ} {C : D.BettiComponent d}
    (hC : D.IsSingletonSupportComponent C)
    {u v : D.FactorizationAt d} (hu : D.componentOf u = C)
    (hv : D.componentOf v = C) : u = v := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [D.factorization_eq_single_of_singleton_component hC hu,
    D.factorization_eq_single_of_singleton_component hC hv]
  apply congrArg (Finsupp.single (D.singletonSupportVariable C))
  have hdu := D.factorizationAt_degree u
  have hdv := D.factorizationAt_degree v
  rw [D.factorization_eq_single_of_singleton_component hC hu] at hdu
  rw [D.factorization_eq_single_of_singleton_component hC hv] at hdv
  simp only [D.weightedDegree_single] at hdu hdv
  have hn : 0 < D.n (D.singletonSupportVariable C) := D.positive _
  exact Nat.mul_right_cancel hn (hdu.trans hdv.symm)

/-- The fiber at `d` has a singleton-support component on variable `j`. -/
def HasSingletonComponentAt (j : Fin 4) (d : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ C : D.BettiComponent d,
    D.IsSingletonSupportComponent C ∧ D.singletonSupportVariable C = j

private theorem singleton_degree_lt_impossible {j : Fin 4} {d₁ d₂ : ℕ}
    (h₁ : D.IsBettiDegree d₁) (h₂ : D.IsBettiDegree d₂)
    {C₁ : D.BettiComponent d₁} (hC₁ : D.IsSingletonSupportComponent C₁)
    (hj₁ : D.singletonSupportVariable C₁ = j)
    {C₂ : D.BettiComponent d₂} (hC₂ : D.IsSingletonSupportComponent C₂)
    (hj₂ : D.singletonSupportVariable C₂ = j)
    {u₁ : D.FactorizationAt d₁} (hu₁ : D.componentOf u₁ = C₁)
    {u₂ : D.FactorizationAt d₂} (hu₂ : D.componentOf u₂ = C₂)
    (hm : u₁.1 j < u₂.1 j) : False := by
  classical
  have hc₁gt : 1 < Fintype.card (D.BettiComponent d₁) := by
    unfold IsBettiDegree componentCount at h₁
    omega
  obtain ⟨E, hEC⟩ := Fintype.exists_ne_of_one_lt_card hc₁gt C₁
  have hEn : (D.componentSupport E).Nonempty :=
    D.componentSupport_nonempty_of_isBetti h₁ E
  obtain ⟨k, hkE⟩ := hEn
  obtain ⟨v, hvE, hvk⟩ := D.mem_componentSupport_iff.mp hkE
  have hC₁support : D.componentSupport C₁ = {j} := by
    rw [D.componentSupport_eq_singleton hC₁, hj₁]
  have hC₂support : D.componentSupport C₂ = {j} := by
    rw [D.componentSupport_eq_singleton hC₂, hj₂]
  have hjC₁ : j ∈ D.componentSupport C₁ := by simp [hC₁support]
  have hvj : v.1 j = 0 := by
    by_contra hvj0
    have hjE : j ∈ D.componentSupport E :=
      D.mem_componentSupport_iff.mpr ⟨v, hvE, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hvj0⟩
    exact (Finset.disjoint_left.mp (D.componentSupport_disjoint hEC) hjE hjC₁)
  have hkj : k ≠ j := by
    intro h
    subst k
    exact (Nat.ne_of_gt hvk) hvj
  have hu₁pure := D.factorization_eq_single_of_singleton_component hC₁ hu₁
  have hu₂pure := D.factorization_eq_single_of_singleton_component hC₂ hu₂
  rw [hj₁] at hu₁pure
  rw [hj₂] at hu₂pure
  have hd₁ : d₁ = u₁.1 j * D.n j :=
    (D.factorizationAt_degree u₁).symm.trans
      ((congrArg D.weightedDegree hu₁pure).trans (D.weightedDegree_single j _))
  have hd₂ : d₂ = u₂.1 j * D.n j :=
    (D.factorizationAt_degree u₂).symm.trans
      ((congrArg D.weightedDegree hu₂pure).trans (D.weightedDegree_single j _))
  let shift : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ := Finsupp.single j (u₂.1 j - u₁.1 j)
  have hshiftDegree : D.weightedDegree (v.1 + shift) = d₂ := by
    rw [show D.weightedDegree (v.1 + shift) =
      D.weightedDegree v.1 + D.weightedDegree shift from weightedDegreeOf_add D.n v.1 shift]
    rw [show D.weightedDegree shift = (u₂.1 j - u₁.1 j) * D.n j by
      exact D.weightedDegree_single j _]
    rw [D.factorizationAt_degree v]
    calc
      d₁ + (u₂.1 j - u₁.1 j) * D.n j =
          u₁.1 j * D.n j + (u₂.1 j - u₁.1 j) * D.n j :=
        congrArg (fun z => z + (u₂.1 j - u₁.1 j) * D.n j) hd₁
      _ = (u₁.1 j + (u₂.1 j - u₁.1 j)) * D.n j := (Nat.add_mul ..).symm
      _ = u₂.1 j * D.n j :=
        congrArg (fun z => z * D.n j) (Nat.add_sub_of_le (Nat.le_of_lt hm))
      _ = d₂ := hd₂.symm
  let w : D.FactorizationAt d₂ :=
    ⟨v.1 + shift, D.mem_factorizations.mpr hshiftDegree⟩
  have hwj : 0 < w.1 j := by
    change 0 < (v.1 + shift) j
    simp [shift, hvj]
    omega
  have hu₂j : 0 < u₂.1 j := by omega
  have hwu : w ≠ u₂ := by
    intro heq
    have hkEq := congrArg (fun z : D.FactorizationAt d₂ => z.1 k) heq
    change (v.1 + shift) k = u₂.1 k at hkEq
    rw [hu₂pure] at hkEq
    simp [shift, Finsupp.single_apply, hkj] at hkEq
    omega
  have hcompw : D.componentOf w = C₂ := by
    rw [← hu₂]
    exact SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.sound
      ((D.factorizationGraph_adj w u₂).2 ⟨hwu, ⟨j, hwj, hu₂j⟩⟩).reachable
  exact hwu (D.singleton_component_vertex_unique hC₂ hcompw hu₂)

/-- A fixed generator can support a singleton Betti component in at most one
degree.  The proof shifts the smaller pure-power relation symbolically. -/
theorem singletonComponent_degree_unique {j : Fin 4} {d₁ d₂ : ℕ}
    (h₁ : D.IsBettiDegree d₁) (h₂ : D.IsBettiDegree d₂)
    (hs₁ : D.HasSingletonComponentAt j d₁)
    (hs₂ : D.HasSingletonComponentAt j d₂) : d₁ = d₂ := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨C₁, hC₁, hj₁⟩ := hs₁
  obtain ⟨C₂, hC₂, hj₂⟩ := hs₂
  obtain ⟨u₁, hu₁⟩ := SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.nonempty_supp C₁
  obtain ⟨u₂, hu₂⟩ := SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.nonempty_supp C₂
  have hu₁C : D.componentOf u₁ = C₁ :=
    (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff C₁ u₁).mp hu₁
  have hu₂C : D.componentOf u₂ = C₂ :=
    (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff C₂ u₂).mp hu₂
  have hpure₁ := D.factorization_eq_single_of_singleton_component hC₁ hu₁C
  have hpure₂ := D.factorization_eq_single_of_singleton_component hC₂ hu₂C
  rw [hj₁] at hpure₁
  rw [hj₂] at hpure₂
  have hd₁ : d₁ = u₁.1 j * D.n j :=
    (D.factorizationAt_degree u₁).symm.trans
      ((congrArg D.weightedDegree hpure₁).trans (D.weightedDegree_single j _))
  have hd₂ : d₂ = u₂.1 j * D.n j :=
    (D.factorizationAt_degree u₂).symm.trans
      ((congrArg D.weightedDegree hpure₂).trans (D.weightedDegree_single j _))
  rcases lt_trichotomy (u₁.1 j) (u₂.1 j) with hlt | heq | hgt
  · exact False.elim (D.singleton_degree_lt_impossible h₁ h₂ hC₁ hj₁ hC₂ hj₂
      hu₁C hu₂C hlt)
  · simpa [hd₁, hd₂, heq]
  · exact False.elim (D.singleton_degree_lt_impossible h₂ h₁ hC₂ hj₂ hC₁ hj₁
      hu₂C hu₁C hgt)

/-- A singleton component at a Betti degree, retained with its degree. -/
structure SingletonBettiOccurrence where
  degree : ℕ
  isBetti : D.IsBettiDegree degree
  component : D.BettiComponent degree
  singleton : D.IsSingletonSupportComponent component

/-- The unique variable supporting a singleton occurrence. -/
def singletonOccurrenceVariable (o : D.SingletonBettiOccurrence) : Fin 4 :=
  D.singletonSupportVariable o.component

theorem singletonOccurrenceVariable_injective :
    Function.Injective D.singletonOccurrenceVariable := by
  intro a b hab
  rcases a with ⟨d₁, hd₁, C₁, hC₁⟩
  rcases b with ⟨d₂, hd₂, C₂, hC₂⟩
  dsimp [singletonOccurrenceVariable] at hab
  have hdeg : d₁ = d₂ := D.singletonComponent_degree_unique hd₁ hd₂
    ⟨C₁, hC₁, rfl⟩ ⟨C₂, hC₂, hab.symm⟩
  subst d₂
  have hcomp : C₁ = C₂ := by
    by_contra hne
    have hmem₁ := D.singletonSupportVariable_mem hC₁
    have hmem₂ := D.singletonSupportVariable_mem hC₂
    rw [hab] at hmem₁
    exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp (D.componentSupport_disjoint hne) hmem₁ hmem₂
  subst C₂
  rfl

noncomputable instance singletonBettiOccurrenceFinite :
    Finite (D.SingletonBettiOccurrence) :=
  Finite.of_injective D.singletonOccurrenceVariable D.singletonOccurrenceVariable_injective

noncomputable instance singletonBettiOccurrenceFintype :
    Fintype (D.SingletonBettiOccurrence) := Fintype.ofFinite _

theorem singletonBettiOccurrence_card_le_four :
    Fintype.card (D.SingletonBettiOccurrence) ≤ 4 := by
  simpa using Fintype.card_le_of_injective D.singletonOccurrenceVariable
    D.singletonOccurrenceVariable_injective

theorem supportCard_eq_componentSupport_sum (d : ℕ) :
    D.supportCard d = ∑ C : D.BettiComponent d, (D.componentSupport C).card := by
  classical
  have hp : (↑(Finset.univ : Finset (D.BettiComponent d)) : Set (D.BettiComponent d)).PairwiseDisjoint
      D.componentSupport := by
    simpa using D.componentSupport_pairwiseDisjoint d
  have h := Finset.card_biUnion (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (D.BettiComponent d)))
    (t := D.componentSupport) hp

theorem componentCount_le_supportCard_of_isBetti {d : ℕ}
    (hd : D.IsBettiDegree d) : D.componentCount d ≤ D.supportCard d := by

  have hsum := Finset.sum_le_sum
    (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (D.BettiComponent d)))
    (f := fun _ => 1) (g := fun C => (D.componentSupport C).card)
    (fun C _ => Finset.card_pos.mpr (D.componentSupport_nonempty_of_isBetti hd C))

theorem twice_componentCount_le_supportCard_add_singletons {d : ℕ}

  have hpoint : ∀ C : D.BettiComponent d,

    intro C
    have hpos : 0 < (D.componentSupport C).card :=
      Finset.card_pos.mpr (D.componentSupport_nonempty_of_isBetti hd C)
    by_cases hcard : (D.componentSupport C).card = 1
    · simp [IsSingletonSupportComponent, hcard]
    · have hge : 2 ≤ (D.componentSupport C).card := by omega
      simp [IsSingletonSupportComponent, hcard, hge]
  have hsum := Finset.sum_le_sum
    (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (D.BettiComponent d))) (fun C _ => hpoint C)
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib] at hsum
  have hsupport := D.supportCard_eq_componentSupport_sum d
  have hsingle :
      (∑ C : D.BettiComponent d, if D.IsSingletonSupportComponent C then 1 else 0) =

    unfold singletonComponentCount
    simpa using (Finset.sum_boole
      (fun C : D.BettiComponent d => D.IsSingletonSupportComponent C) Finset.univ)

noncomputable instance componentConnectorFintype {d : ℕ} (hd : D.IsBettiDegree d) :
    Fintype (D.ComponentConnector hd) := Fintype.ofFinite _

def componentRepresentative {d : ℕ} (C : D.BettiComponent d) :
    D.FactorizationAt d :=
  Classical.choose (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.nonempty_supp C)

theorem componentRepresentative_component {d : ℕ} (C : D.BettiComponent d) :
    D.componentOf (D.componentRepresentative C) = C :=
  (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff C _).mp
    (Classical.choose_spec (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.nonempty_supp C))

/-- The representative relation joining the root to a non-root component. -/
def connectorEndpoints {d : ℕ} (hd : D.IsBettiDegree d)
    (e : D.ComponentConnector hd) : D.FactorizationAt d × D.FactorizationAt d :=
  (D.componentRepresentative (D.rootComponent hd), D.componentRepresentative e.1)

theorem connectorEndpoints_components {d : ℕ} (hd : D.IsBettiDegree d)
    (e : D.ComponentConnector hd) :
    D.componentOf (D.connectorEndpoints hd e).1 = D.rootComponent hd ∧
      D.componentOf (D.connectorEndpoints hd e).2 = e.1 := by
  exact ⟨D.componentRepresentative_component _, D.componentRepresentative_component _⟩

theorem connectorCount {d : ℕ} (hd : D.IsBettiDegree d) :
    Fintype.card (D.ComponentConnector hd) = D.componentCount d - 1 := by
  classical
  unfold ComponentConnector componentCount
  simpa using Fintype.card_subtype_compl
    (fun C : D.BettiComponent d => C = D.rootComponent hd)

/-- The component-level star graph obtained by adjoining the connector family. -/
def componentConnectorGraph {d : ℕ} (hd : D.IsBettiDegree d) :
    SimpleGraph (D.BettiComponent d) :=
  SimpleGraph.fromRel fun C E => C = D.rootComponent hd ∧ E ≠ D.rootComponent hd

theorem componentConnectorGraph_adj {d : ℕ} (hd : D.IsBettiDegree d)
    (C E : D.BettiComponent d) :
    (D.componentConnectorGraph hd).Adj C E ↔
      C ≠ E ∧ ((C = D.rootComponent hd ∧ E ≠ D.rootComponent hd) ∨
        (E = D.rootComponent hd ∧ C ≠ D.rootComponent hd)) := by
  rfl

theorem componentConnectorGraph_connected {d : ℕ} (hd : D.IsBettiDegree d) :
    (D.componentConnectorGraph hd).Connected := by
  classical
  have hnonempty : Nonempty (D.BettiComponent d) :=
    ⟨D.rootComponent hd⟩
  rw [SimpleGraph.connected_iff]
  refine ⟨?_, hnonempty⟩
  intro C E
  have toRoot (A : D.BettiComponent d) :
      (D.componentConnectorGraph hd).Reachable A (D.rootComponent hd) := by
    by_cases hA : A = D.rootComponent hd
    · subst A
      exact SimpleGraph.Reachable.refl (G := D.componentConnectorGraph hd) _
    · exact ((D.componentConnectorGraph_adj hd A (D.rootComponent hd)).2
        ⟨hA, Or.inr ⟨rfl, hA⟩⟩).reachable
  exact (toRoot C).trans (toRoot E).symm

end Connectors

/-- Scope-explicit stable package for Run 23. -/
structure FourBaseBettiCombinatorics : Prop where
  componentSupportDisjoint : ∀ d (C E : D.BettiComponent d), C ≠ E →
    Disjoint (D.componentSupport C) (D.componentSupport E)
  localInequality : ∀ d, D.IsBettiDegree d →
    (4 - D.supportCard d) * (D.componentCount d - 1) ≤ D.singletonComponentCount d
  singletonDegreeUnique : ∀ j d₁ d₂, D.IsBettiDegree d₁ → D.IsBettiDegree d₂ →
    D.HasSingletonComponentAt j d₁ → D.HasSingletonComponentAt j d₂ → d₁ = d₂
  singletonOccurrenceBound : Fintype.card (D.SingletonBettiOccurrence) ≤ 4
  fourBaseBudgetBound : (∑ i : Fin 4, D.fourBaseBudget i) ≤ 4

theorem fourBaseBettiCombinatorics : D.FourBaseBettiCombinatorics where
  componentSupportDisjoint := fun _ _ _ h => D.componentSupport_disjoint h
  localInequality := fun _ h => D.localSupportInequality h
  singletonDegreeUnique := fun _ _ _ h₁ h₂ hs₁ hs₂ =>
    D.singletonComponent_degree_unique h₁ h₂ hs₁ hs₂
  singletonOccurrenceBound := D.singletonBettiOccurrence_card_le_four
  fourBaseBudgetBound := D.fourBaseBudget_sum_le_four

end FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup

namespace P23.Semigroup

open scoped BigOperators

noncomputable section

/-- Weighted degree for an ordered family of four natural generators. -/
def weightedDegreeOf (n : Fin 4 → ℕ) (u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ∑ j : Fin 4, u j * n j

@[simp] theorem weightedDegreeOf_zero (n : Fin 4 → ℕ) :
    weightedDegreeOf n 0 = 0 := by simp [weightedDegreeOf]

theorem weightedDegreeOf_add (n : Fin 4 → ℕ) (u v : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) :
    weightedDegreeOf n (u + v) = weightedDegreeOf n u + weightedDegreeOf n v := by
  simp [weightedDegreeOf, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

/-- The additive weighted-degree homomorphism. -/
def weightedDegreeHomOf (n : Fin 4 → ℕ) : (Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) →+ ℕ where
  toFun := weightedDegreeOf n
  map_zero' := weightedDegreeOf_zero n
  map_add' := weightedDegreeOf_add n

/-- The additive submonoid generated by the ordered family. -/
def generatedByFour (n : Fin 4 → ℕ) : AddSubmonoid ℕ :=
  AddMonoidHom.mrange (weightedDegreeHomOf n)

/-- Ordered, positive, minimal four-generator data whose generated submonoid
has finite complement in `ℕ`. -/
structure FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup where
  n : Fin 4 → ℕ
  positive : ∀ j, 0 < n j
  injective : Function.Injective n
  minimal : ∀ j (u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ), u j = 0 → weightedDegreeOf n u ≠ n j
  cofinite : Set.Finite {s : ℕ | s ∉ generatedByFour n}

namespace FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup

variable (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup)

/-- Weighted degree attached to the chosen four generators. -/
abbrev weightedDegree (u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) : ℕ := weightedDegreeOf D.n u

/-- The numerical semigroup generated by the four ordered generators. -/
abbrev Gamma : AddSubmonoid ℕ := generatedByFour D.n

/-- Exact generation/factorization interface. -/
theorem mem_Gamma_iff (s : ℕ) :
    s ∈ D.Gamma ↔ ∃ u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ, D.weightedDegree u = s := by
  exact AddMonoidHom.mem_mrange

/-- The coordinate vector selecting one generator. -/
def generatorFactorization (j : Fin 4) : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ := Finsupp.single j 1

@[simp] theorem weightedDegree_generatorFactorization (j : Fin 4) :
    D.weightedDegree (generatorFactorization j) = D.n j := by
  classical
  simp only [weightedDegreeOf, generatorFactorization]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
  · simp
  · intro b _ hbj
    simp [Finsupp.single_apply, hbj]
  · simp

theorem generator_mem_Gamma (j : Fin 4) : D.n j ∈ D.Gamma :=
  (D.mem_Gamma_iff (D.n j)).2 ⟨generatorFactorization j,
    D.weightedDegree_generatorFactorization j⟩

/-- A semigroup element represented as an element of the generated subtype. -/
def generator (j : Fin 4) : D.Gamma := ⟨D.n j, D.generator_mem_Gamma j⟩

/-- A fixed-degree factorization. -/
abbrev Factorization (s : ℕ) := {u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ // D.weightedDegree u = s}

theorem coordinate_le_weightedDegree (u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) (j : Fin 4) :
    u j ≤ D.weightedDegree u := by
  have hterm : u j * D.n j ≤ D.weightedDegree u := by
    apply Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ j)
  have hone : 1 ≤ D.n j := D.positive j
  simpa only [Nat.mul_one] using (Nat.mul_le_mul_left (u j) hone).trans hterm

theorem factorization_coordinate_le {s : ℕ} (u : D.Factorization s) (j : Fin 4) :
    u.1 j ≤ s := by
  simpa [u.2] using D.coordinate_le_weightedDegree u.1 j

instance factorizationFinite (s : ℕ) : Finite (D.Factorization s) := by
  let f : D.Factorization s → (Fin 4 → Fin (s + 1)) := fun u j =>
    ⟨u.1 j, Nat.lt_succ_of_le (D.factorization_coordinate_le u j)⟩
  exact Finite.of_injective f (by
    intro u v h
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Finsupp.ext
    intro j
    exact congrArg (fun g => (g j : ℕ)) h)

/-- The finite set of all exponent vectors of a fixed semigroup degree. -/
def factorizations (s : ℕ) : Finset (Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) :=
  letI := Fintype.ofFinite (D.Factorization s)
  Finset.univ.image (fun u : D.Factorization s => u.1)

@[simp] theorem mem_factorizations {s : ℕ} {u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ} :
    u ∈ D.factorizations s ↔ D.weightedDegree u = s := by
  classical
  simp [factorizations]

/-- The selected base generator. -/
def base (i : Fin 4) : D.Gamma := D.generator i

/-- The exact embedding of the three tail indices into the four indices. -/
def tailIndex (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup) (i : Fin 4) : Fin 3 ↪ Fin 4 :=
  i.succAboveEmb

@[simp] theorem tailIndex_apply (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) :
    D.tailIndex i j = i.succAbove j := rfl

theorem tailIndex_ne_base (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) : D.tailIndex i j ≠ i := by
  simpa [tailIndex] using Fin.succAbove_ne i j

theorem tailIndex_injective (i : Fin 4) : Function.Injective (D.tailIndex i) :=
  (D.tailIndex i).injective

/-- The three generators other than the selected base. -/
def tailGen (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) : ℕ := D.n (D.tailIndex i j)

theorem tailGen_positive (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) : 0 < D.tailGen i j :=
  D.positive _

theorem tailGen_injective (i : Fin 4) : Function.Injective (D.tailGen i) :=
  D.injective.comp (D.tailIndex_injective i)

theorem tailGen_ne_base (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) : D.tailGen i j ≠ D.n i := by
  exact fun h => D.tailIndex_ne_base i j (D.injective h)

/-- Tail generator as a semigroup element. -/
def tail (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) : D.Gamma := D.generator (D.tailIndex i j)

/-- Apéry membership is absence of an additive predecessor by the selected
base.  This definition deliberately avoids truncated subtraction. -/
def IsApery (i : Fin 4) (s : D.Gamma) : Prop :=
  ¬ ∃ h : D.Gamma, s = D.base i + h

theorem zero_isApery (i : Fin 4) : D.IsApery i 0 := by
  rintro ⟨h, hh⟩
  have := congrArg Subtype.val hh
  have hq := D.positive i
  simp only [AddSubmonoid.coe_zero, AddSubmonoid.coe_add, base, generator] at this
  omega

theorem base_not_isApery (i : Fin 4) : ¬ D.IsApery i (D.base i) := by
  refine fun h => h ⟨0, ?_⟩
  simp

private theorem weighted_term_le (u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) (j : Fin 4) :
    u j * D.n j ≤ D.weightedDegree u := by
  apply Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ j)

theorem tail_isApery (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) : D.IsApery i (D.tail i j) := by
  rintro ⟨h, hh⟩
  rcases (D.mem_Gamma_iff h.1).1 h.2 with ⟨u, hu⟩
  let tj : Fin 4 := D.tailIndex i j
  have heq : D.n tj = D.n i + D.weightedDegree u := by
    have hraw := congrArg Subtype.val hh
    have hraw' : D.n tj = D.n i + h.1 := by
      simpa [tj, tail, generator, base] using hraw
    rw [hraw', hu]
  have hut : u tj = 0 := by
    by_contra hne
    have hone : 1 ≤ u tj := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 hne
    have hterm := D.weighted_term_le u tj
    have hmul : D.n tj ≤ u tj * D.n tj := by
      simpa [one_mul] using Nat.mul_le_mul_right (D.n tj) hone
    have hni := D.positive i
    omega

/-- Weighted degree for an ordered family of four natural generators. -/
def weightedDegreeOf (n : Fin 4 → ℕ) (u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ∑ j : Fin 4, u j * n j

@[simp] theorem weightedDegreeOf_zero (n : Fin 4 → ℕ) :
    weightedDegreeOf n 0 = 0 := by simp [weightedDegreeOf]

theorem weightedDegreeOf_add (n : Fin 4 → ℕ) (u v : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) :
    weightedDegreeOf n (u + v) = weightedDegreeOf n u + weightedDegreeOf n v := by
  simp [weightedDegreeOf, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

/-- The additive weighted-degree homomorphism. -/
def weightedDegreeHomOf (n : Fin 4 → ℕ) : (Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) →+ ℕ where
  toFun := weightedDegreeOf n
  map_zero' := weightedDegreeOf_zero n
  map_add' := weightedDegreeOf_add n

/-- The additive submonoid generated by the ordered family. -/
def generatedByFour (n : Fin 4 → ℕ) : AddSubmonoid ℕ :=
  AddMonoidHom.mrange (weightedDegreeHomOf n)

/-- Ordered, positive, minimal four-generator data whose generated submonoid
has finite complement in `ℕ`. -/
structure FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup where
  n : Fin 4 → ℕ
  positive : ∀ j, 0 < n j
  injective : Function.Injective n
  minimal : ∀ j (u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ), u j = 0 → weightedDegreeOf n u ≠ n j
  cofinite : Set.Finite {s : ℕ | s ∉ generatedByFour n}

namespace FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup

variable (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup)

/-- Weighted degree attached to the chosen four generators. -/
abbrev weightedDegree (u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) : ℕ := weightedDegreeOf D.n u

/-- The numerical semigroup generated by the four ordered generators. -/
abbrev Gamma : AddSubmonoid ℕ := generatedByFour D.n

/-- Exact generation/factorization interface. -/
theorem mem_Gamma_iff (s : ℕ) :
    s ∈ D.Gamma ↔ ∃ u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ, D.weightedDegree u = s := by
  exact AddMonoidHom.mem_mrange

/-- The coordinate vector selecting one generator. -/
def generatorFactorization (j : Fin 4) : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ := Finsupp.single j 1

@[simp] theorem weightedDegree_generatorFactorization (j : Fin 4) :
    D.weightedDegree (generatorFactorization j) = D.n j := by
  classical
  simp only [weightedDegreeOf, generatorFactorization]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
  · simp
  · intro b _ hbj
    simp [Finsupp.single_apply, hbj]
  · simp

  (D.mem_Gamma_iff (D.n j)).2 ⟨generatorFactorization j,
    D.weightedDegree_generatorFactorization j⟩

/-- A semigroup element represented as an element of the generated subtype. -/
def generator (j : Fin 4) : D.Gamma := ⟨D.n j, D.generator_mem_Gamma j⟩

/-- A fixed-degree factorization. -/
abbrev Factorization (s : ℕ) := {u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ // D.weightedDegree u = s}

theorem coordinate_le_weightedDegree (u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) (j : Fin 4) :
    u j ≤ D.weightedDegree u := by
  have hterm : u j * D.n j ≤ D.weightedDegree u := by
    apply Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ j)
  have hone : 1 ≤ D.n j := D.positive j
  simpa only [Nat.mul_one] using (Nat.mul_le_mul_left (u j) hone).trans hterm

theorem factorization_coordinate_le {s : ℕ} (u : D.Factorization s) (j : Fin 4) :
    u.1 j ≤ s := by
  simpa [u.2] using D.coordinate_le_weightedDegree u.1 j

instance factorizationFinite (s : ℕ) : Finite (D.Factorization s) := by
  let f : D.Factorization s → (Fin 4 → Fin (s + 1)) := fun u j =>
    ⟨u.1 j, Nat.lt_succ_of_le (D.factorization_coordinate_le u j)⟩
  exact Finite.of_injective f (by
    intro u v h
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Finsupp.ext
    intro j
    exact congrArg (fun g => (g j : ℕ)) h)

/-- The finite set of all exponent vectors of a fixed semigroup degree. -/
def factorizations (s : ℕ) : Finset (Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) :=
  letI := Fintype.ofFinite (D.Factorization s)
  Finset.univ.image (fun u : D.Factorization s => u.1)

@[simp] theorem mem_factorizations {s : ℕ} {u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ} :
    u ∈ D.factorizations s ↔ D.weightedDegree u = s := by
  classical
  simp [factorizations]

/-- The selected base generator. -/
def base (i : Fin 4) : D.Gamma := D.generator i

/-- The exact embedding of the three tail indices into the four indices. -/
def tailIndex (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup) (i : Fin 4) : Fin 3 ↪ Fin 4 :=

  simpa [tailIndex] using Fin.succAbove_ne i j

theorem tailIndex_injective (i : Fin 4) : Function.Injective (D.tailIndex i) :=

/-- The three generators other than the selected base. -/

theorem tailGen_positive (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) : 0 < D.tailGen i j :=

theorem tailGen_injective (i : Fin 4) : Function.Injective (D.tailGen i) :=

theorem tailGen_ne_base (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) : D.tailGen i j ≠ D.n i := by

/-- Tail generator as a semigroup element. -/

/-- Apéry membership is absence of an additive predecessor by the selected

  have hq := D.positive i

  refine fun h => h ⟨0, ?_⟩
  simp

private theorem weighted_term_le (u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) (j : Fin 4) :
    u j * D.n j ≤ D.weightedDegree u := by
  apply Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ j)

theorem tail_isApery (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) : D.IsApery i (D.tail i j) := by

  rcases (D.mem_Gamma_iff h.1).1 h.2 with ⟨u, hu⟩

    rw [hraw', hu]

    have hone : 1 ≤ u tj := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 hne
    have hterm := D.weighted_term_le u tj
    have hmul : D.n tj ≤ u tj * D.n tj := by
      simpa [one_mul] using Nat.mul_le_mul_right (D.n tj) hone
    have hni := D.positive i
    omega

def gapFinset : Finset ℕ := D.cofinite.toFinset

@[simp] theorem mem_gapFinset (s : ℕ) : s ∈ D.gapFinset ↔ s ∉ D.Gamma := by
  simp [gapFinset]

/-- A concrete conductor bound extracted from cofiniteness. -/
def conductor : ℕ := D.gapFinset.sup id + 1

theorem mem_Gamma_of_conductor_le {s : ℕ} (hs : D.conductor ≤ s) : s ∈ D.Gamma := by
  by_contra hnot
  have hmem : s ∈ D.gapFinset := (D.mem_gapFinset s).2 hnot
  have hle : s ≤ D.gapFinset.sup id := Finset.le_sup (f := id) hmem
  simp [conductor] at hs
  omega

theorem isApery_lt (i : Fin 4) {s : D.Gamma} (hs : D.IsApery i s) :
    s.1 < D.conductor + D.n i := by
  by_contra hnot
  have hqi : D.n i ≤ s.1 := by
    have hc : D.conductor ≤ s.1 := by omega
    have hq := D.positive i
    omega
  let d : ℕ := s.1 - D.n i
  have hdcond : D.conductor ≤ d := by omega
  have hdmem : d ∈ D.Gamma := D.mem_Gamma_of_conductor_le hdcond

  apply Subtype.ext
  simp [base, generator, d, Nat.add_sub_of_le hqi]

instance aperyIndexFinite (i : Fin 4) : Finite (D.AperyIndex i) := by
  let f : D.AperyIndex i → Fin (D.conductor + D.n i) := fun s =>
    ⟨s.1.1, D.isApery_lt i s.2⟩
  exact Finite.of_injective f (by
    intro s t h
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact congrArg Fin.val h)

/-- Exact finite Apéry set inside the semigroup subtype. -/
def aperyFinset (i : Fin 4) : Finset D.Gamma :=
  letI := Fintype.ofFinite (D.AperyIndex i)
  Finset.univ.map
    (⟨fun s : D.AperyIndex i => s.1, Subtype.val_injective⟩ :
      D.AperyIndex i ↪ D.Gamma)

@[simp] theorem mem_aperyFinset (i : Fin 4) (s : D.Gamma) :
    s ∈ D.aperyFinset i ↔ D.IsApery i s := by
  classical
  simp [aperyFinset]

theorem zero_mem_aperyFinset (i : Fin 4) : 0 ∈ D.aperyFinset i := by
  simpa using D.zero_isApery i

theorem base_not_mem_aperyFinset (i : Fin 4) : D.base i ∉ D.aperyFinset i := by
  simpa using D.base_not_isApery i

theorem tail_mem_aperyFinset (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) :
    D.tail i j ∈ D.aperyFinset i := by
  simpa using D.tail_isApery i j

/-- Any factorization of an Apéry degree has zero coordinate at the chosen
base.  This is the symbolic bridge used by the tail presentation; no
factorization uniqueness is asserted. -/
theorem apery_factorization_base_eq_zero (i : Fin 4) {s : D.Gamma}
    (hs : D.IsApery i s) (u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) (hu : D.weightedDegree u = s.1) :
    u i = 0 := by
  by_contra hnonzero
  have hui : 0 < u i := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hnonzero
  let v : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ := Finsupp.single i (u i - 1) + u.erase i
  have huv : u = Finsupp.single i 1 + v := by
    apply Finsupp.ext
    intro j
    by_cases hji : j = i
    · subst j
      simp [v]
      omega
    · simp [v, Finsupp.single_apply, hji]
  have hvGamma : D.weightedDegree v ∈ D.Gamma :=
    (D.mem_Gamma_iff _).2 ⟨v, rfl⟩
  apply hs
  refine ⟨⟨D.weightedDegree v, hvGamma⟩, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hsingle : D.weightedDegree (Finsupp.single i 1) = D.n i := by
    simpa [generatorFactorization] using D.weightedDegree_generatorFactorization i
  rw [← hu, huv]
  change weightedDegreeOf D.n (Finsupp.single i 1 + v) =
    D.n i + weightedDegreeOf D.n v
  change weightedDegreeOf D.n (Finsupp.single i 1) = D.n i at hsingle
  rw [weightedDegreeOf_add, hsingle]

def weightedDegreeOf (n : Fin 4 → ℕ) (u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ∑ j : Fin 4, u j * n j

@[simp] theorem weightedDegreeOf_zero (n : Fin 4 → ℕ) :
    weightedDegreeOf n 0 = 0 := by simp [weightedDegreeOf]

theorem weightedDegreeOf_add (n : Fin 4 → ℕ) (u v : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) :
    weightedDegreeOf n (u + v) = weightedDegreeOf n u + weightedDegreeOf n v := by
  simp [weightedDegreeOf, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

/-- The additive weighted-degree homomorphism. -/
def weightedDegreeHomOf (n : Fin 4 → ℕ) : (Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) →+ ℕ where
  toFun := weightedDegreeOf n
  map_zero' := weightedDegreeOf_zero n
  map_add' := weightedDegreeOf_add n

/-- The additive submonoid generated by the ordered family. -/
def generatedByFour (n : Fin 4 → ℕ) : AddSubmonoid ℕ :=
  AddMonoidHom.mrange (weightedDegreeHomOf n)

/-- Ordered, positive, minimal four-generator data whose generated submonoid
has finite complement in `ℕ`. -/
structure FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup where
  n : Fin 4 → ℕ
  positive : ∀ j, 0 < n j
  injective : Function.Injective n
  minimal : ∀ j (u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ), u j = 0 → weightedDegreeOf n u ≠ n j
  cofinite : Set.Finite {s : ℕ | s ∉ generatedByFour n}

namespace FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup

variable (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup)

/-- Weighted degree attached to the chosen four generators. -/
abbrev weightedDegree (u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) : ℕ := weightedDegreeOf D.n u

/-- The numerical semigroup generated by the four ordered generators. -/
abbrev Gamma : AddSubmonoid ℕ := generatedByFour D.n

/-- Exact generation/factorization interface. -/
theorem mem_Gamma_iff (s : ℕ) :
    s ∈ D.Gamma ↔ ∃ u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ, D.weightedDegree u = s := by
  exact AddMonoidHom.mem_mrange

/-- The coordinate vector selecting one generator. -/
def generatorFactorization (j : Fin 4) : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ := Finsupp.single j 1

@[simp] theorem weightedDegree_generatorFactorization (j : Fin 4) :
    D.weightedDegree (generatorFactorization j) = D.n j := by
  classical
  simp only [weightedDegreeOf, generatorFactorization]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
  · simp
  · intro b _ hbj
    simp [Finsupp.single_apply, hbj]
  · simp

theorem generator_mem_Gamma (j : Fin 4) : D.n j ∈ D.Gamma :=
  (D.mem_Gamma_iff (D.n j)).2 ⟨generatorFactorization j,
    D.weightedDegree_generatorFactorization j⟩

/-- A semigroup element represented as an element of the generated subtype. -/
def generator (j : Fin 4) : D.Gamma := ⟨D.n j, D.generator_mem_Gamma j⟩

/-- A fixed-degree factorization. -/
abbrev Factorization (s : ℕ) := {u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ // D.weightedDegree u = s}

theorem coordinate_le_weightedDegree (u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) (j : Fin 4) :
    u j ≤ D.weightedDegree u := by
  have hterm : u j * D.n j ≤ D.weightedDegree u := by
    apply Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ j)
  have hone : 1 ≤ D.n j := D.positive j
  simpa only [Nat.mul_one] using (Nat.mul_le_mul_left (u j) hone).trans hterm

theorem factorization_coordinate_le {s : ℕ} (u : D.Factorization s) (j : Fin 4) :
    u.1 j ≤ s := by
  simpa [u.2] using D.coordinate_le_weightedDegree u.1 j

instance factorizationFinite (s : ℕ) : Finite (D.Factorization s) := by
  let f : D.Factorization s → (Fin 4 → Fin (s + 1)) := fun u j =>
    ⟨u.1 j, Nat.lt_succ_of_le (D.factorization_coordinate_le u j)⟩
  exact Finite.of_injective f (by
    intro u v h
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Finsupp.ext
    intro j
    exact congrArg (fun g => (g j : ℕ)) h)

/-- The finite set of all exponent vectors of a fixed semigroup degree. -/
def factorizations (s : ℕ) : Finset (Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) :=
  letI := Fintype.ofFinite (D.Factorization s)
  Finset.univ.image (fun u : D.Factorization s => u.1)

@[simp] theorem mem_factorizations {s : ℕ} {u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ} :
    u ∈ D.factorizations s ↔ D.weightedDegree u = s := by
  classical
  simp [factorizations]

/-- The selected base generator. -/
def base (i : Fin 4) : D.Gamma := D.generator i

/-- The exact embedding of the three tail indices into the four indices. -/
def tailIndex (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup) (i : Fin 4) : Fin 3 ↪ Fin 4 :=
  i.succAboveEmb

@[simp] theorem tailIndex_apply (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) :
    D.tailIndex i j = i.succAbove j := rfl

theorem tailIndex_ne_base (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) : D.tailIndex i j ≠ i := by
  simpa [tailIndex] using Fin.succAbove_ne i j

theorem tailIndex_injective (i : Fin 4) : Function.Injective (D.tailIndex i) :=
  (D.tailIndex i).injective

/-- The three generators other than the selected base. -/
def tailGen (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) : ℕ := D.n (D.tailIndex i j)

theorem tailGen_positive (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) : 0 < D.tailGen i j :=
  D.positive _

theorem tailGen_injective (i : Fin 4) : Function.Injective (D.tailGen i) :=
  D.injective.comp (D.tailIndex_injective i)

theorem tailGen_ne_base (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) : D.tailGen i j ≠ D.n i := by
  exact fun h => D.tailIndex_ne_base i j (D.injective h)

/-- Tail generator as a semigroup element. -/
def tail (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) : D.Gamma := D.generator (D.tailIndex i j)

/-- Apéry membership is absence of an additive predecessor by the selected
base.  This definition deliberately avoids truncated subtraction. -/
def IsApery (i : Fin 4) (s : D.Gamma) : Prop :=
  ¬ ∃ h : D.Gamma, s = D.base i + h

theorem zero_isApery (i : Fin 4) : D.IsApery i 0 := by
  rintro ⟨h, hh⟩
  have := congrArg Subtype.val hh
  have hq := D.positive i
  simp only [AddSubmonoid.coe_zero, AddSubmonoid.coe_add, base, generator] at this
  omega

theorem base_not_isApery (i : Fin 4) : ¬ D.IsApery i (D.base i) := by
  refine fun h => h ⟨0, ?_⟩
  simp

private theorem weighted_term_le (u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) (j : Fin 4) :
    u j * D.n j ≤ D.weightedDegree u := by
  apply Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ j)

theorem tail_isApery (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) : D.IsApery i (D.tail i j) := by
  rintro ⟨h, hh⟩
  rcases (D.mem_Gamma_iff h.1).1 h.2 with ⟨u, hu⟩
  let tj : Fin 4 := D.tailIndex i j
  have heq : D.n tj = D.n i + D.weightedDegree u := by
    have hraw := congrArg Subtype.val hh
    have hraw' : D.n tj = D.n i + h.1 := by
      simpa [tj, tail, generator, base] using hraw
    rw [hraw', hu]
  have hut : u tj = 0 := by
    by_contra hne
    have hone : 1 ≤ u tj := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 hne
    have hterm := D.weighted_term_le u tj
    have hmul : D.n tj ≤ u tj * D.n tj := by
      simpa [one_mul] using Nat.mul_le_mul_right (D.n tj) hone
    have hni := D.positive i
    omega
  let v : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ := Finsupp.single i 1 + u
  have hvzero : v tj = 0 := by
    have hit : i ≠ tj := (D.tailIndex_ne_base i j).symm
    simp [v, Finsupp.single_apply, hit, hut]
  have hsingle : weightedDegreeOf D.n (Finsupp.single i 1) = D.n i := by
    simpa [generatorFactorization] using D.weightedDegree_generatorFactorization i
  have hvdeg : D.weightedDegree v = D.n tj := by
    change weightedDegreeOf D.n v = D.n tj
    rw [show v = Finsupp.single i 1 + u by rfl, weightedDegreeOf_add, hsingle]
    exact heq.symm
  exact (D.minimal tj v hvzero) hvdeg

/-- The finite set of gaps of the generated semigroup. -/
def gapFinset : Finset ℕ := D.cofinite.toFinset

@[simp] theorem mem_gapFinset (s : ℕ) : s ∈ D.gapFinset ↔ s ∉ D.Gamma := by
  simp [gapFinset]

/-- A concrete conductor bound extracted from cofiniteness. -/
def conductor : ℕ := D.gapFinset.sup id + 1

theorem mem_Gamma_of_conductor_le {s : ℕ} (hs : D.conductor ≤ s) : s ∈ D.Gamma := by
  by_contra hnot
  have hmem : s ∈ D.gapFinset := (D.mem_gapFinset s).2 hnot
  have hle : s ≤ D.gapFinset.sup id := Finset.le_sup (f := id) hmem
  simp [conductor] at hs
  omega

theorem isApery_lt (i : Fin 4) {s : D.Gamma} (hs : D.IsApery i s) :
    s.1 < D.conductor + D.n i := by
  by_contra hnot
  have hqi : D.n i ≤ s.1 := by
    have hc : D.conductor ≤ s.1 := by omega
    have hq := D.positive i
    omega
  let d : ℕ := s.1 - D.n i
  have hdcond : D.conductor ≤ d := by omega
  have hdmem : d ∈ D.Gamma := D.mem_Gamma_of_conductor_le hdcond
  apply hs
  refine ⟨⟨d, hdmem⟩, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp [base, generator, d, Nat.add_sub_of_le hqi]

/-- The finite subtype indexing the Apéry basis. -/
abbrev AperyIndex (i : Fin 4) := {s : D.Gamma // D.IsApery i s}

instance aperyIndexFinite (i : Fin 4) : Finite (D.AperyIndex i) := by
  let f : D.AperyIndex i → Fin (D.conductor + D.n i) := fun s =>
    ⟨s.1.1, D.isApery_lt i s.2⟩
  exact Finite.of_injective f (by
    intro s t h
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact congrArg Fin.val h)

/-- Exact finite Apéry set inside the semigroup subtype. -/
def aperyFinset (i : Fin 4) : Finset D.Gamma :=
  letI := Fintype.ofFinite (D.AperyIndex i)
  Finset.univ.map
    (⟨fun s : D.AperyIndex i => s.1, Subtype.val_injective⟩ :
      D.AperyIndex i ↪ D.Gamma)

@[simp] theorem mem_aperyFinset (i : Fin 4) (s : D.Gamma) :
    s ∈ D.aperyFinset i ↔ D.IsApery i s := by
  classical
  simp [aperyFinset]

theorem zero_mem_aperyFinset (i : Fin 4) : 0 ∈ D.aperyFinset i := by
  simpa using D.zero_isApery i

theorem base_not_mem_aperyFinset (i : Fin 4) : D.base i ∉ D.aperyFinset i := by
  simpa using D.base_not_isApery i

theorem tail_mem_aperyFinset (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) :
    D.tail i j ∈ D.aperyFinset i := by
  simpa using D.tail_isApery i j

/-- Any factorization of an Apéry degree has zero coordinate at the chosen
base.  This is the symbolic bridge used by the tail presentation; no
factorization uniqueness is asserted. -/
theorem apery_factorization_base_eq_zero (i : Fin 4) {s : D.Gamma}
    (hs : D.IsApery i s) (u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) (hu : D.weightedDegree u = s.1) :
    u i = 0 := by
  by_contra hnonzero
  have hui : 0 < u i := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hnonzero
  let v : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ := Finsupp.single i (u i - 1) + u.erase i
  have huv : u = Finsupp.single i 1 + v := by
    apply Finsupp.ext
    intro j
    by_cases hji : j = i
    · subst j
      simp [v]
      omega
    · simp [v, Finsupp.single_apply, hji]
  have hvGamma : D.weightedDegree v ∈ D.Gamma :=
    (D.mem_Gamma_iff _).2 ⟨v, rfl⟩
  apply hs
  refine ⟨⟨D.weightedDegree v, hvGamma⟩, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hsingle : D.weightedDegree (Finsupp.single i 1) = D.n i := by
    simpa [generatorFactorization] using D.weightedDegree_generatorFactorization i
  rw [← hu, huv]
  change weightedDegreeOf D.n (Finsupp.single i 1 + v) =
    D.n i + weightedDegreeOf D.n v
  change weightedDegreeOf D.n (Finsupp.single i 1) = D.n i at hsingle
  rw [weightedDegreeOf_add, hsingle]

end FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup

end

end P23.Semigroup

def aperyResidue (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup) (i : Fin 4)
    (s : D.AperyIndex i) : ZMod (D.n i) := s.1.1

private theorem apery_eq_of_le_residue (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup) (i : Fin 4)
    (s t : D.AperyIndex i) (hle : s.1.1 ≤ t.1.1)
    (he : aperyResidue D i s = aperyResidue D i t) : s=t := by
  have hm : s.1.1 ≡ t.1.1 [MOD D.n i] := (ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff _ _ _).mp he
  obtain ⟨k,hk⟩ := (Nat.modEq_iff_exists_eq_add hle).mp hm
  cases k with
  | zero => apply Subtype.ext; apply Subtype.ext; simpa using hk.symm
  | succ k =>
    exfalso
    apply t.2
    refine ⟨s.1 + k • D.base i, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    change t.1.1 = D.n i + (s.1.1 + k * D.n i)
    rw [hk]; ring

theorem aperyResidue_injective (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup) (i : Fin 4) :
    Function.Injective (aperyResidue D i) := by
  intro s t he
  rcases le_total s.1.1 t.1.1 with h | h
  · exact apery_eq_of_le_residue D i s t h he
  · exact (apery_eq_of_le_residue D i t s h he.symm).symm

theorem aperyResidue_surjective (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup) (i : Fin 4) :
    Function.Surjective (aperyResidue D i) := by
  classical
  letI : NeZero (D.n i) := ⟨Nat.ne_of_gt (D.positive i)⟩
  intro r
  let P : ℕ → Prop := fun s => s ∈ D.Gamma ∧ (s : ZMod (D.n i))=r
  have hex : ∃ s, P s := by
    refine ⟨r.val + D.conductor * D.n i, ?_, ?_⟩
    · apply D.mem_Gamma_of_conductor_le
      have := Nat.mul_le_mul_left D.conductor (D.positive i)
      omega
    · simp
  let s := Nat.find hex
  have hs := Nat.find_spec hex
  have ha : D.IsApery i ⟨s,hs.1⟩ := by
    rintro ⟨h,he⟩
    have hval : s=D.n i+h.1 := congrArg Subtype.val he
    have hp : P h.1 := by
      refine ⟨h.2, ?_⟩
      have hh := hs.2
      change (s : ZMod (D.n i))=r at hh
      rw [hval] at hh
      simpa using hh
    have hh := Nat.find_min' hex hp
    have hq := D.positive i
    omega
  exact ⟨⟨⟨s,hs.1⟩,ha⟩,hs.2⟩

def aperyResidueEquiv (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup) (i : Fin 4) :
    D.AperyIndex i ≃ ZMod (D.n i) :=
  Equiv.ofBijective (aperyResidue D i) ⟨aperyResidue_injective D i,aperyResidue_surjective D i⟩

theorem aperyIndex_card (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup) (i : Fin 4) :
    Nat.card (D.AperyIndex i)=D.n i := by
  letI : NeZero (D.n i) := ⟨Nat.ne_of_gt (D.positive i)⟩
  rw [Nat.card_congr (aperyResidueEquiv D i),Nat.card_eq_fintype_card,ZMod.card]

end
end P23.Semigroup.FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup

@[simp] theorem mem_factorizations {s : ℕ} {u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ} :
    u ∈ D.factorizations s ↔ D.weightedDegree u = s := by
  classical
  simp [factorizations]

/-- The selected base generator. -/
def base (i : Fin 4) : D.Gamma := D.generator i

/-- The exact embedding of the three tail indices into the four indices. -/
def tailIndex (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup) (i : Fin 4) : Fin 3 ↪ Fin 4 :=
  i.succAboveEmb

@[simp] theorem tailIndex_apply (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) :
    D.tailIndex i j = i.succAbove j := rfl

theorem tailIndex_ne_base (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) : D.tailIndex i j ≠ i := by
  simpa [tailIndex] using Fin.succAbove_ne i j

theorem tailIndex_injective (i : Fin 4) : Function.Injective (D.tailIndex i) :=
  (D.tailIndex i).injective

/-- The three generators other than the selected base. -/
def tailGen (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) : ℕ := D.n (D.tailIndex i j)

theorem tailGen_positive (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) : 0 < D.tailGen i j :=
  D.positive _

theorem tailGen_injective (i : Fin 4) : Function.Injective (D.tailGen i) :=
  D.injective.comp (D.tailIndex_injective i)

theorem tailGen_ne_base (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) : D.tailGen i j ≠ D.n i := by
  exact fun h => D.tailIndex_ne_base i j (D.injective h)

/-- Tail generator as a semigroup element. -/
def tail (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) : D.Gamma := D.generator (D.tailIndex i j)

/-- Apéry membership is absence of an additive predecessor by the selected
base.  This definition deliberately avoids truncated subtraction. -/
def IsApery (i : Fin 4) (s : D.Gamma) : Prop :=
  ¬ ∃ h : D.Gamma, s = D.base i + h

theorem zero_isApery (i : Fin 4) : D.IsApery i 0 := by
  rintro ⟨h, hh⟩
  have := congrArg Subtype.val hh
  have hq := D.positive i
  simp only [AddSubmonoid.coe_zero, AddSubmonoid.coe_add, base, generator] at this
  omega

theorem base_not_isApery (i : Fin 4) : ¬ D.IsApery i (D.base i) := by
  refine fun h => h ⟨0, ?_⟩
  simp

private theorem weighted_term_le (u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) (j : Fin 4) :
    u j * D.n j ≤ D.weightedDegree u := by
  apply Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ j)

theorem tail_isApery (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) : D.IsApery i (D.tail i j) := by
  rintro ⟨h, hh⟩
  rcases (D.mem_Gamma_iff h.1).1 h.2 with ⟨u, hu⟩
  let tj : Fin 4 := D.tailIndex i j
  have heq : D.n tj = D.n i + D.weightedDegree u := by
    have hraw := congrArg Subtype.val hh
    have hraw' : D.n tj = D.n i + h.1 := by
      simpa [tj, tail, generator, base] using hraw
    rw [hraw', hu]
  have hut : u tj = 0 := by
    by_contra hne
    have hone : 1 ≤ u tj := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 hne
    have hterm := D.weighted_term_le u tj
    have hmul : D.n tj ≤ u tj * D.n tj := by
      simpa [one_mul] using Nat.mul_le_mul_right (D.n tj) hone
    have hni := D.positive i
    omega
  let v : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ := Finsupp.single i 1 + u
  have hvzero : v tj = 0 := by
    have hit : i ≠ tj := (D.tailIndex_ne_base i j).symm
    simp [v, Finsupp.single_apply, hit, hut]
  have hsingle : weightedDegreeOf D.n (Finsupp.single i 1) = D.n i := by
    simpa [generatorFactorization] using D.weightedDegree_generatorFactorization i
  have hvdeg : D.weightedDegree v = D.n tj := by
    change weightedDegreeOf D.n v = D.n tj
    rw [show v = Finsupp.single i 1 + u by rfl, weightedDegreeOf_add, hsingle]
    exact heq.symm
  exact (D.minimal tj v hvzero) hvdeg

/-- The finite set of gaps of the generated semigroup. -/
def gapFinset : Finset ℕ := D.cofinite.toFinset

@[simp] theorem mem_gapFinset (s : ℕ) : s ∈ D.gapFinset ↔ s ∉ D.Gamma := by
  simp [gapFinset]

/-- A concrete conductor bound extracted from cofiniteness. -/
def conductor : ℕ := D.gapFinset.sup id + 1

theorem mem_Gamma_of_conductor_le {s : ℕ} (hs : D.conductor ≤ s) : s ∈ D.Gamma := by
  by_contra hnot
  have hmem : s ∈ D.gapFinset := (D.mem_gapFinset s).2 hnot
  have hle : s ≤ D.gapFinset.sup id := Finset.le_sup (f := id) hmem
  simp [conductor] at hs
  omega

theorem isApery_lt (i : Fin 4) {s : D.Gamma} (hs : D.IsApery i s) :
    s.1 < D.conductor + D.n i := by
  by_contra hnot
  have hqi : D.n i ≤ s.1 := by
    have hc : D.conductor ≤ s.1 := by omega
    have hq := D.positive i
    omega
  let d : ℕ := s.1 - D.n i
  have hdcond : D.conductor ≤ d := by omega
  have hdmem : d ∈ D.Gamma := D.mem_Gamma_of_conductor_le hdcond
  apply hs
  refine ⟨⟨d, hdmem⟩, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp [base, generator, d, Nat.add_sub_of_le hqi]

/-- The finite subtype indexing the Apéry basis. -/
abbrev AperyIndex (i : Fin 4) := {s : D.Gamma // D.IsApery i s}

instance aperyIndexFinite (i : Fin 4) : Finite (D.AperyIndex i) := by
  let f : D.AperyIndex i → Fin (D.conductor + D.n i) := fun s =>
    ⟨s.1.1, D.isApery_lt i s.2⟩
  exact Finite.of_injective f (by
    intro s t h
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact congrArg Fin.val h)

/-- Exact finite Apéry set inside the semigroup subtype. -/
def aperyFinset (i : Fin 4) : Finset D.Gamma :=
  letI := Fintype.ofFinite (D.AperyIndex i)
  Finset.univ.map
    (⟨fun s : D.AperyIndex i => s.1, Subtype.val_injective⟩ :
      D.AperyIndex i ↪ D.Gamma)

@[simp] theorem mem_aperyFinset (i : Fin 4) (s : D.Gamma) :
    s ∈ D.aperyFinset i ↔ D.IsApery i s := by
  classical
  simp [aperyFinset]

theorem zero_mem_aperyFinset (i : Fin 4) : 0 ∈ D.aperyFinset i := by
  simpa using D.zero_isApery i

theorem base_not_mem_aperyFinset (i : Fin 4) : D.base i ∉ D.aperyFinset i := by
  simpa using D.base_not_isApery i

theorem tail_mem_aperyFinset (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) :
    D.tail i j ∈ D.aperyFinset i := by
  simpa using D.tail_isApery i j

/-- Any factorization of an Apéry degree has zero coordinate at the chosen
base.  This is the symbolic bridge used by the tail presentation; no
factorization uniqueness is asserted. -/
theorem apery_factorization_base_eq_zero (i : Fin 4) {s : D.Gamma}
    (hs : D.IsApery i s) (u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) (hu : D.weightedDegree u = s.1) :
    u i = 0 := by
  by_contra hnonzero
  have hui : 0 < u i := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hnonzero
  let v : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ := Finsupp.single i (u i - 1) + u.erase i
  have huv : u = Finsupp.single i 1 + v := by
    apply Finsupp.ext
    intro j
    by_cases hji : j = i
    · subst j
      simp [v]
      omega
    · simp [v, Finsupp.single_apply, hji]
  have hvGamma : D.weightedDegree v ∈ D.Gamma :=
    (D.mem_Gamma_iff _).2 ⟨v, rfl⟩
  apply hs
  refine ⟨⟨D.weightedDegree v, hvGamma⟩, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hsingle : D.weightedDegree (Finsupp.single i 1) = D.n i := by
    simpa [generatorFactorization] using D.weightedDegree_generatorFactorization i
  rw [← hu, huv]
  change weightedDegreeOf D.n (Finsupp.single i 1 + v) =
    D.n i + weightedDegreeOf D.n v
  change weightedDegreeOf D.n (Finsupp.single i 1) = D.n i at hsingle
  rw [weightedDegreeOf_add, hsingle]

end FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup

def aperyResidue (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup) (i : Fin 4)
    (s : D.AperyIndex i) : ZMod (D.n i) := s.1.1

private theorem apery_eq_of_le_residue (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup) (i : Fin 4)
    (s t : D.AperyIndex i) (hle : s.1.1 ≤ t.1.1)
    (he : aperyResidue D i s = aperyResidue D i t) : s=t := by
  have hm : s.1.1 ≡ t.1.1 [MOD D.n i] := (ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff _ _ _).mp he
  obtain ⟨k,hk⟩ := (Nat.modEq_iff_exists_eq_add hle).mp hm
  cases k with
  | zero => apply Subtype.ext; apply Subtype.ext; simpa using hk.symm
  | succ k =>
    exfalso
    apply t.2
    refine ⟨s.1 + k • D.base i, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    change t.1.1 = D.n i + (s.1.1 + k * D.n i)
    rw [hk]; ring

theorem aperyResidue_injective (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup) (i : Fin 4) :
    Function.Injective (aperyResidue D i) := by
  intro s t he
  rcases le_total s.1.1 t.1.1 with h | h
  · exact apery_eq_of_le_residue D i s t h he
  · exact (apery_eq_of_le_residue D i t s h he.symm).symm

theorem aperyResidue_surjective (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup) (i : Fin 4) :
    Function.Surjective (aperyResidue D i) := by
  classical
  letI : NeZero (D.n i) := ⟨Nat.ne_of_gt (D.positive i)⟩
  intro r
  let P : ℕ → Prop := fun s => s ∈ D.Gamma ∧ (s : ZMod (D.n i))=r
  have hex : ∃ s, P s := by
    refine ⟨r.val + D.conductor * D.n i, ?_, ?_⟩
    · apply D.mem_Gamma_of_conductor_le
      have := Nat.mul_le_mul_left D.conductor (D.positive i)
      omega
    · simp
  let s := Nat.find hex
  have hs := Nat.find_spec hex
  have ha : D.IsApery i ⟨s,hs.1⟩ := by
    rintro ⟨h,he⟩
    have hval : s=D.n i+h.1 := congrArg Subtype.val he
    have hp : P h.1 := by
      refine ⟨h.2, ?_⟩
      have hh := hs.2
      change (s : ZMod (D.n i))=r at hh
      rw [hval] at hh
      simpa using hh
    have hh := Nat.find_min' hex hp
    have hq := D.positive i
    omega
  exact ⟨⟨⟨s,hs.1⟩,ha⟩,hs.2⟩

def aperyResidueEquiv (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup) (i : Fin 4) :
    D.AperyIndex i ≃ ZMod (D.n i) :=
  Equiv.ofBijective (aperyResidue D i) ⟨aperyResidue_injective D i,aperyResidue_surjective D i⟩

theorem aperyIndex_card (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup) (i : Fin 4) :
    Nat.card (D.AperyIndex i)=D.n i := by
  letI : NeZero (D.n i) := ⟨Nat.ne_of_gt (D.positive i)⟩
  rw [Nat.card_congr (aperyResidueEquiv D i),Nat.card_eq_fintype_card,ZMod.card]

/-- Weighted degree for an ordered family of four natural generators. -/
def weightedDegreeOf (n : Fin 4 → ℕ) (u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ∑ j : Fin 4, u j * n j

@[simp] theorem weightedDegreeOf_zero (n : Fin 4 → ℕ) :
    weightedDegreeOf n 0 = 0 := by simp [weightedDegreeOf]

theorem weightedDegreeOf_add (n : Fin 4 → ℕ) (u v : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) :
    weightedDegreeOf n (u + v) = weightedDegreeOf n u + weightedDegreeOf n v := by
  simp [weightedDegreeOf, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

/-- The additive weighted-degree homomorphism. -/
def weightedDegreeHomOf (n : Fin 4 → ℕ) : (Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) →+ ℕ where
  toFun := weightedDegreeOf n
  map_zero' := weightedDegreeOf_zero n
  map_add' := weightedDegreeOf_add n

/-- The additive submonoid generated by the ordered family. -/
def generatedByFour (n : Fin 4 → ℕ) : AddSubmonoid ℕ :=
  AddMonoidHom.mrange (weightedDegreeHomOf n)

/-- Ordered, positive, minimal four-generator data whose generated submonoid
has finite complement in `ℕ`. -/
structure FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup where
  n : Fin 4 → ℕ
  positive : ∀ j, 0 < n j
  injective : Function.Injective n
  minimal : ∀ j (u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ), u j = 0 → weightedDegreeOf n u ≠ n j
  cofinite : Set.Finite {s : ℕ | s ∉ generatedByFour n}

namespace FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup

variable (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup)

/-- Weighted degree attached to the chosen four generators. -/
abbrev weightedDegree (u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) : ℕ := weightedDegreeOf D.n u

/-- The numerical semigroup generated by the four ordered generators. -/
abbrev Gamma : AddSubmonoid ℕ := generatedByFour D.n

theorem mem_Gamma_iff (s : ℕ) :
    s ∈ D.Gamma ↔ ∃ u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ, D.weightedDegree u = s := by
  exact AddMonoidHom.mem_mrange

/-- The coordinate vector selecting one generator. -/
def generatorFactorization (j : Fin 4) : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ := Finsupp.single j 1

@[simp] theorem weightedDegree_generatorFactorization (j : Fin 4) :
    D.weightedDegree (generatorFactorization j) = D.n j := by
  classical
  simp only [weightedDegreeOf, generatorFactorization]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
  · simp
  · intro b _ hbj
    simp [Finsupp.single_apply, hbj]
  · simp

theorem tailIndex_injective (i : Fin 4) : Function.Injective (D.tailIndex i) :=

theorem tailGen_ne_base (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) : D.tailGen i j ≠ D.n i := by

theorem tail_isApery (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) : D.IsApery i (D.tail i j) := by

theorem weightedDegreeOf_add (n : Fin 4 → ℕ) (u v : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) :

  map_add' := weightedDegreeOf_add n

    apply Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ j)

    have hterm := D.weighted_term_le u tj

  by_contra hnot
  have hmem : s ∈ D.gapFinset := (D.mem_gapFinset s).2 hnot
  have hle : s ≤ D.gapFinset.sup id := Finset.le_sup (f := id) hmem
  simp [conductor] at hs
  omega

  by_contra hnot
  have hqi : D.n i ≤ s.1 := by
    have hc : D.conductor ≤ s.1 := by omega
    have hq := D.positive i
    omega
  let d : ℕ := s.1 - D.n i
  have hdcond : D.conductor ≤ d := by omega
  have hdmem : d ∈ D.Gamma := D.mem_Gamma_of_conductor_le hdcond
  apply hs
  refine ⟨⟨d, hdmem⟩, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp [base, generator, d, Nat.add_sub_of_le hqi]

  let f : D.AperyIndex i → Fin (D.conductor + D.n i) := fun s =>

  exact Finite.of_injective f (by

    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact congrArg Fin.val h)

  letI := Fintype.ofFinite (D.AperyIndex i)
  Finset.univ.map
    (⟨fun s : D.AperyIndex i => s.1, Subtype.val_injective⟩ :
      D.AperyIndex i ↪ D.Gamma)

    s ∈ D.aperyFinset i ↔ D.IsApery i s := by
  classical
  simp [aperyFinset]

theorem zero_mem_aperyFinset (i : Fin 4) : 0 ∈ D.aperyFinset i := by
  simpa using D.zero_isApery i

theorem base_not_mem_aperyFinset (i : Fin 4) : D.base i ∉ D.aperyFinset i := by
  simpa using D.base_not_isApery i

theorem tail_mem_aperyFinset (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) :

  simpa using D.tail_isApery i j

theorem apery_factorization_base_eq_zero (i : Fin 4) {s : D.Gamma}
    (hs : D.IsApery i s) (u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) (hu : D.weightedDegree u = s.1) :
    u i = 0 := by
  by_contra hnonzero
  have hui : 0 < u i := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hnonzero
  let v : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ := Finsupp.single i (u i - 1) + u.erase i
  have huv : u = Finsupp.single i 1 + v := by
    apply Finsupp.ext
    intro j
    by_cases hji : j = i
    · subst j
      simp [v]
      omega
    · simp [v, Finsupp.single_apply, hji]
  have hvGamma : D.weightedDegree v ∈ D.Gamma :=
    (D.mem_Gamma_iff _).2 ⟨v, rfl⟩
  apply hs
  refine ⟨⟨D.weightedDegree v, hvGamma⟩, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hsingle : D.weightedDegree (Finsupp.single i 1) = D.n i := by
    simpa [generatorFactorization] using D.weightedDegree_generatorFactorization i
  rw [← hu, huv]
  change weightedDegreeOf D.n (Finsupp.single i 1 + v) =
    D.n i + weightedDegreeOf D.n v
  change weightedDegreeOf D.n (Finsupp.single i 1) = D.n i at hsingle
  rw [weightedDegreeOf_add, hsingle]

/-- Weighted degree for an ordered family of four natural generators. -/
def weightedDegreeOf (n : Fin 4 → ℕ) (u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ∑ j : Fin 4, u j * n j

@[simp] theorem weightedDegreeOf_zero (n : Fin 4 → ℕ) :
    weightedDegreeOf n 0 = 0 := by simp [weightedDegreeOf]

theorem weightedDegreeOf_add (n : Fin 4 → ℕ) (u v : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) :
    weightedDegreeOf n (u + v) = weightedDegreeOf n u + weightedDegreeOf n v := by
  simp [weightedDegreeOf, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

/-- The additive weighted-degree homomorphism. -/
def weightedDegreeHomOf (n : Fin 4 → ℕ) : (Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) →+ ℕ where
  toFun := weightedDegreeOf n
  map_zero' := weightedDegreeOf_zero n
  map_add' := weightedDegreeOf_add n

/-- The additive submonoid generated by the ordered family. -/
def generatedByFour (n : Fin 4 → ℕ) : AddSubmonoid ℕ :=
  AddMonoidHom.mrange (weightedDegreeHomOf n)

/-- Ordered, positive, minimal four-generator data whose generated submonoid
has finite complement in `ℕ`. -/
structure FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup where
  n : Fin 4 → ℕ
  positive : ∀ j, 0 < n j
  injective : Function.Injective n
  minimal : ∀ j (u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ), u j = 0 → weightedDegreeOf n u ≠ n j
  cofinite : Set.Finite {s : ℕ | s ∉ generatedByFour n}

namespace FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup

variable (D : FourGeneratedNumericalSemigroup)

/-- Weighted degree attached to the chosen four generators. -/
abbrev weightedDegree (u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) : ℕ := weightedDegreeOf D.n u

/-- The numerical semigroup generated by the four ordered generators. -/
abbrev Gamma : AddSubmonoid ℕ := generatedByFour D.n

/-- Exact generation/factorization interface. -/
theorem mem_Gamma_iff (s : ℕ) :
    s ∈ D.Gamma ↔ ∃ u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ, D.weightedDegree u = s := by
  exact AddMonoidHom.mem_mrange

/-- The coordinate vector selecting one generator. -/
def generatorFactorization (j : Fin 4) : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ := Finsupp.single j 1

@[simp] theorem weightedDegree_generatorFactorization (j : Fin 4) :
    D.weightedDegree (generatorFactorization j) = D.n j := by
  classical
  simp only [weightedDegreeOf, generatorFactorization]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
  · simp
  · intro b _ hbj
    simp [Finsupp.single_apply, hbj]
  · simp

theorem generator_mem_Gamma (j : Fin 4) : D.n j ∈ D.Gamma :=
  (D.mem_Gamma_iff (D.n j)).2 ⟨generatorFactorization j,
    D.weightedDegree_generatorFactorization j⟩

/-- A semigroup element represented as an element of the generated subtype. -/
def generator (j : Fin 4) : D.Gamma := ⟨D.n j, D.generator_mem_Gamma j⟩

/-- A fixed-degree factorization. -/
abbrev Factorization (s : ℕ) := {u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ // D.weightedDegree u = s}

theorem coordinate_le_weightedDegree (u : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) (j : Fin 4) :
    u j ≤ D.weightedDegree u := by
  have hterm : u j * D.n j ≤ D.weightedDegree u := by
    apply Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ j)
  have hone : 1 ≤ D.n j := D.positive j
  simpa only [Nat.mul_one] using (Nat.mul_le_mul_left (u j) hone).trans hterm

theorem factorization_coordinate_le {s : ℕ} (u : D.Factorization s) (j : Fin 4) :
    u.1 j ≤ s := by
  simpa [u.2] using D.coordinate_le_weightedDegree u.1 j

instance factorizationFinite (s : ℕ) : Finite (D.Factorization s) := by
  let f : D.Factorization s → (Fin 4 → Fin (s + 1)) := fun u j =>
    ⟨u.1 j, Nat.lt_succ_of_le (D.factorization_coordinate_le u j)⟩
  exact Finite.of_injective f (by
    intro u v h
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Finsupp.ext
    intro j
    exact congrArg (fun g => (g j : ℕ)) h)

/-- The finite set of all exponent vectors of a fixed semigroup degree. -/
def factorizations (s : ℕ) : Finset (Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) :=
  letI := Fintype.ofFinite (D.Factorization s)
  Finset.univ.image (fun u : D.Factorization s => u.1)

    u ∈ D.factorizations s ↔ D.weightedDegree u = s := by

  simp [factorizations]

theorem tailIndex_ne_base (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) : D.tailIndex i j ≠ i := by
  simpa [tailIndex] using Fin.succAbove_ne i j

theorem tailIndex_injective (i : Fin 4) : Function.Injective (D.tailIndex i) :=

theorem tailGen_ne_base (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) : D.tailGen i j ≠ D.n i := by
